title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full-Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities, an aptitude for learning new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, reducing operating costs, saving time, and increasing profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision-support systems once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on Linux, nginx (engine x), fpm, and mostly MySQL
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning



REQUIRED (Must Have):

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and Linux
  • Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences, must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement
  • Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications
  • Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best practices, and reviewing pull requests
  • Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting
  • Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies
  • Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to ensure deadlines are met with high quality
  • Team player with practical communication skills and collaborative approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly
  • Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change, with the passion and drive to excel in their career
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable


PREFERRED (But NOT Required):

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiar with nginx web server (aka "Engine X")
  • Experience with React.js or Vue.js
  • Familiarity with the upstream and midstream oil/gas industry


What YOU Get!

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Understand how to use a web browser console log in the debugging process
  • Understanding of Public/Priviate IP addresses and Domain names
  • Understanding what a Firewall does
  • What does a Proxy Server do
  • Understanding of the basics of SSO


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Representante de Vendas
description:
About Refer

Refer is an exclusive AI-powered career agent that connects top talent from Stanford, MIT, Harvard, and other top 20 US universities to leading tech companies like NVIDIA, Meta, Glean, DeepMind, Scale AI, and 1,000+ startups.


We are expanding rapidly and launching a Refer & Earn program so more people can help us grow this elite talent community — and get rewarded for it.


✨ About the Role

We’re looking for Sales Representatives who want a flexible, remote opportunity to help talented people find great jobs — and get paid extremely well for it.


This is not a typical “marketing” or “recruiting” job.


Your role is simple:

Share Refer with people who qualify

When they join and get accepted — you earn

If they get hired — you earn big

That's it.


Compensation (Commission Only)

You earn:

  • $50 for every qualified user you bring who signs up
  • $1,000 if they get hired or make a hire through Refer

There is no limit to how much you can earn.

Some ambassadors make a few hundred dollars per week.

Some make thousands.


Who Should Apply

This role is perfect for people who:

  • Are active on LinkedIn
  • Have friends from top universities
  • Know people in tech or startups
  • Are involved in online communities
  • Want a flexible side gig with high upside
  • Want to help people find jobs that match their potential

No experience required.

Just bring people to Refer — we do the rest.


Who Qualifies to Be Referred

You’ll have the most success referring people who are:

  • Job seekers with a degree from a top 20 US university , OR
  • Hiring managers / team leads at top tech companies or startups
  • US-based only

You’ll receive more details and tools after joining.


What You’ll Do

As a Sales Representative, you will:

  • Promote Refer
  • Post about Refer in relevant online communities
  • Invite top talent and hiring managers to join
  • Use your unique invitation link to track earnings
  • Help us grow the strongest talent network in the country

We’ll provide:

  • Messaging templates
  • Guidance on where to promote
  • Best practices to maximize your earnings

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React.js / Python)
description:

You will join our clients' innovative, growing team on a mission to unleash the power of culture for growing organizational brands at a time of global, seismic cultural transformation.

You will participate in the complete software development process from conception to deployment of our clients ' world-class data and insights platform. You will work closely with product and UX leads, providing a critical voice in solutioning complex workflows and user experiences.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, then you are the right person for the job. The ideal candidate must collaborate well within a team, leverage strong technological expertise, and adeptly analyze and prioritize features and requirements. You will build upon our clients' next-generation front-end user experience, connecting it to and enhancing the backend data pipeline.

Our client unleashes the power of culture to drive brand growth through consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 major U.S. brands. Its solutions are powered by its cultural intelligence platform, which enables its customers to understand, reach, and engage consumers more effectively and efficiently, activating them across race, ethnicity, generation, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • Work with development teams and product managers to ideate software solutions
  • Architect and build application front-ends with appealing visual design
  • Develop functional, scalable applications
  • Write effective APIs
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software
  • Create security and data protection settings
  • Build features and applications with a mobile-responsive design
  • Write technical documentation
  • Work with data scientists and analysts to improve AI/ML-based software


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience primarily using React.js in the front-end
  • Knowledge of additional front-end languages and libraries (e.g., HTML / CSS, JavaScript, XML, and jQuery)
  • 2+ years working in AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud platform
  • 1+ years of Python experience
  • Familiarity with databases (e.g., MySQL and MongoDB), web servers (e.g., Apache), and UI/UX design
  • Great attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and an analytical mind
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, statistics, or a relevant field
  • Experience with DataViz
  • Experience with Snowflake, Flask, Django, or FastAPI


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)
description:
About PhilSocial:


PhilSocial is a blockchain-powered Give-to-Earn platform transforming how social media influences the world. Valued at $1.2 B (2024) and empowering over 250,000 users worldwide , PhilSocial merges the best of social media with the best of humanity — creating the world’s first peer-to-peer social movement . We empower people to give, connect, and earn — bringing impact and generosity to the center of digital life.


About Position:

Position: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)


Role Overview:


We’re looking for a mid- to senior-level Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in React Native and Python (FastAPI) , familiar with AWS cloud architectures , and passionate about writing elegant, clean, and scalable code.

You’ll join a cross-functional global team (Brazil, USA, Dubai, Spain, Ukraine, Colombia, and more) responsible for building new, complex features for the next phase of PhilSocial — while maintaining and improving current modules of our social media platform.

You’ll work remotely and collaborate daily with our Tech Lead in Brazil and Corporate Teams in the US and Dubai .


Responsibilities:


  • Develop new features and modules for the PhilSocial mobile app (React Native + Expo / CLI).
  • Maintain and refactor existing code with a focus on scalability, performance, and security.
  • Implement RESTful and asynchronous APIs using FastAPI , aligned with DDD and Hexagonal Architecture principles.
  • Collaborate with designers, blockchain engineers, and backend specialists to build seamless user experiences.
  • Contribute to system architecture discussions and participate in technical design reviews.
  • Write well-tested, documented, and maintainable code following Clean Code / SOLID practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and optimize API performance on AWS (Fargate, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront, etc.).
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews across time zones.


Requirements:


Frontend / Mobile (React Native):

  • React Native (Expo & CLI)
  • Zustand (state management)
  • MMKV (persistent storage)
  • React Query (data fetching & caching)
  • TypeScript


Backend (Python / FastAPI):

  • FastAPI, Pydantic, Async I/O
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  • SOLID principles
  • Hexagonal architecture
  • REST / GraphQL API design
  • AWS (Lambda, Fargate, EKS, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Web3 / Blockchain integrations
  • Familiarity with smart contracts or Solid protocol


Leadership Skills:

  • Ability to design scalable systems and make key technical decisions.
  • Experience leading 2–8 developers with accountability for delivery.
  • Clear communication, mentoring, and Agile mindset.


You’ll Succeed in This Role If You:

  • Are a go-to problem solver — you diagnose and fix complex issues independently.
  • Deliver high-quality, efficient, and clean code with excellent attention to detail.
  • Demonstrate technical leadership — mentoring others and influencing best practices.
  • Have strong time management — you’re reliable and proactive across global teams.
  • Communicate clearly in English (written & spoken intermediate+) ;
  • Thrive in a remote, multicultural environment , collaborating asynchronously when needed.


We offer:

  • Meaningful projects in social digital finance that impact real users.
  • Modern React stack, flexibility, and product ownership culture.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Full-time role in an international environment.


Compensation & Engagement:

  • Contract Type: Full-time Contractor (Remote)
  • Monthly Rate: based on experience and region
  • Work Schedule: Flexible / Global Team Coordination
  • Location: Anywhere (PhilSocial operates globally)


How to Apply:

Send your CV / Portfolio / GitHub to with the subject line:

“Full-Stack Developer – PhilSocial”

  • Include links to any relevant repositories or apps you’ve built.

description:

title: UI Designer
description:

  • Experience in Automotive Fields.

  • Analysis and benchmarking skills.
  • Identification of the technology that can at best intercept and satisfy customer requests with those offered by the reference market.

  • Customer orientation and ability to speak in public and facing the client.
  • Team work ability and empathy



Work Model

The candidate can work remotely and must be available to be contacted via Microsoft Teams for any meetings during European business hours.

title: Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Canva.
  • Experience building support documentation, macros, or knowledge base articles.
  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote Position! Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and skill development.
  • Take Your Local Holidays: We respect your cultural and personal commitments.
  • Impact: Join a mission-driven U.S. startup where your work directly enhances customer experience and revenue operations.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

O cargo requer motivação, exige um profissional que consegue navegar negócios complexos, e com aprendizado rápido.

1.       Vendas e Desenvolvimento de Negócios B2B Enterprise (80% do Tempo)

·     Identificação e Qualificação : Prospectar e qualificar ativamente contas B2B (pequenas a grandes empresas) que se encaixam no nosso Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

·     Gestão do Ciclo de Vendas: Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas B2B, desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento do contrato, negociando propostas complexas e contratos de longo prazo.

·     Demonstração e Prova de Valor : Realizar demonstrações de produto convincentes, articulando claramente o ROI (Retorno sobre Investimento) e o valor da nossa solução para as necessidades específicas do cliente.

·     Metas : Alcançar e superar as metas (targets) de receita e novos negócios estabelecidas para o segmento Enterprise.

2.       Estratégia Go-to-Market (GTM) e Feedback de Produto (20% do Tempo)

·     Validação de PMF : Conduzir ou participar de entrevistas e sessões de feedback aprofundadas com prospects e clientes para identificar pain points e necessidades de mercado não atendidas.

·     Nos ajudar a determinar Unique Selling Propositions (USPs) .

·     Roadmap de Produto: Atuar como a voz do cliente Enterprise internamente, transformando o feedback coletado em requisitos de produto claros e priorizados para o time de Desenvolvimento/Produto.

·     Posicionamento: Testar e refinar continuamente nossa mensagem de GTM, proposta de valor e pricing para maximizar a conversão no mercado Enterprise.

Essenciais:

  • Experiência comprovada em Vendas B2B , preferencialmente no segmento da saúde .
  • Habilidade excepcional de comunicação , negociação e apresentação para executivos.
  • Personalidade proativa , dinâmica , que gosta de apreender e de trabalhar em ambientes complexos e desafiadores .

Diferenciais:

title: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)
description:
About PhilSocial:


PhilSocial is a blockchain-powered Give-to-Earn platform transforming how social media influences the world. Valued at $1.2 B (2024) and empowering over 250,000 users worldwide , PhilSocial merges the best of social media with the best of humanity — creating the world’s first peer-to-peer social movement . We empower people to give, connect, and earn — bringing impact and generosity to the center of digital life.


About Position:

Position: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)


Role Overview:


We’re looking for a mid- to senior-level Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in React Native and Python (FastAPI) , familiar with AWS cloud architectures , and passionate about writing elegant, clean, and scalable code.

You’ll join a cross-functional global team (Brazil, USA, Dubai, Spain, Ukraine, Colombia, and more) responsible for building new, complex features for the next phase of PhilSocial — while maintaining and improving current modules of our social media platform.

You’ll work remotely and collaborate daily with our Tech Lead in Brazil and Corporate Teams in the US and Dubai .


Responsibilities:


  • Develop new features and modules for the PhilSocial mobile app (React Native + Expo / CLI).
  • Maintain and refactor existing code with a focus on scalability, performance, and security.
  • Implement RESTful and asynchronous APIs using FastAPI , aligned with DDD and Hexagonal Architecture principles.
  • Collaborate with designers, blockchain engineers, and backend specialists to build seamless user experiences.
  • Contribute to system architecture discussions and participate in technical design reviews.
  • Write well-tested, documented, and maintainable code following Clean Code / SOLID practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and optimize API performance on AWS (Fargate, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront, etc.).
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews across time zones.


Requirements:


Frontend / Mobile (React Native):

  • React Native (Expo & CLI)
  • Zustand (state management)
  • MMKV (persistent storage)
  • React Query (data fetching & caching)
  • TypeScript


Backend (Python / FastAPI):

  • FastAPI, Pydantic, Async I/O
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  • SOLID principles
  • Hexagonal architecture
  • REST / GraphQL API design
  • AWS (Lambda, Fargate, EKS, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Web3 / Blockchain integrations
  • Familiarity with smart contracts or Solid protocol


Leadership Skills:

  • Ability to design scalable systems and make key technical decisions.
  • Experience leading 2–8 developers with accountability for delivery.
  • Clear communication, mentoring, and Agile mindset.


You’ll Succeed in This Role If You:

  • Are a go-to problem solver — you diagnose and fix complex issues independently.
  • Deliver high-quality, efficient, and clean code with excellent attention to detail.
  • Demonstrate technical leadership — mentoring others and influencing best practices.
  • Have strong time management — you’re reliable and proactive across global teams.
  • Communicate clearly in English (written & spoken intermediate+) ;
  • Thrive in a remote, multicultural environment , collaborating asynchronously when needed.


We offer:

  • Meaningful projects in social digital finance that impact real users.
  • Modern React stack, flexibility, and product ownership culture.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Full-time role in an international environment.


Compensation & Engagement:

  • Contract Type: Full-time Contractor (Remote)
  • Monthly Rate: based on experience and region
  • Work Schedule: Flexible / Global Team Coordination
  • Location: Anywhere (PhilSocial operates globally)


How to Apply:

Send your CV / Portfolio / GitHub to with the subject line:

“Full-Stack Developer – PhilSocial”

  • Include links to any relevant repositories or apps you’ve built.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
QAT Global – 100% Remote (Brazil Only – CLT hire)

QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking highly-skilled Java Full-Stack Developers with strong English communication skills to join our global engineering team. You will collaborate directly with our US-based customer and work with distributed development teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


About the Role


As a Java Full-Stack Developer, you will be responsible for building mission-critical backend services and front-end components that support a large-scale financial platform. You will work across domains involving profiles, billing, ledger, invoicing, and payment flows, contributing to both core business logic and customer-facing UI experiences.

This role requires strong expertise in modern full-stack engineering combined with practical experience using AI-assisted development workflows , LLMs, and prompt engineering to accelerate delivery while maintaining high quality.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain backend services across key financial modules (Profile, Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Recurring, Receipt, Remittance).
  • Build and enhance front-end components used in the Administration UI and Payment Widget.
  • Implement business logic, domain models, API endpoints, and cross-service integrations.
  • Work with frameworks defined by the architecture team (likely Java/Kotlin on the backend, TypeScript/React on the frontend).
  • Collaborate closely with QA engineers to ensure functional completeness and application stability.
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to generate code, improve documentation, and create automated tests.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies and work effectively with distributed teams.


Required Experience


  • Strong hands-on experience with Java (Spring Boot) , Node.js , and React .
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and relational data modeling.
  • Familiarity with Security / DevOps / Cloud practices.
  • Knowledge of GitHub CI/CD pipelines , versioning, and workflow automation.
  • Practical usage of GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency checks).
  • Experience with AWS IAM (roles, policies, permission boundaries).
  • Experience deploying or maintaining workloads on EC2 , RDS , and SQS .
  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities applied to software development (code generation, code review, refactoring, writing automated tests, requirement analysis).
  • Experience with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or willingness to learn quickly.
  • Ability to apply prompt engineering techniques to:
  • debug and reason about code
  • generate high-quality and consistent implementations
  • enforce architectural patterns and constraints
  • interpret technical and business requirements
  • Understanding of safe and responsible AI usage, including hallucination mitigation, validation steps, and code verification.
  • Basic familiarity with AI-powered IDEs (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, JetBrains AI Assistant, etc.).


Preferred Qualifications


  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent fields.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Operations Analytics
description:
We're looking for a Operations Analytics 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Operations Analytics professional to deliver high-impact insights that support our end-to-end operations. In this role, you will work closely with teams across inventory, logistics, retail, and customer service, while partnering with technology and finance stakeholders. You’ll engage with nearly all aspects of a growing business to measure performance, identify opportunities, and drive alignment toward the most impactful operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze, understand, and quantify key operational efficiency metrics.
  • Design, implement, and report on item-level data throughout receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows.
  • Provide daily reporting and product-health measurements to support business decision-making.
  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively to partner teams and leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations analysts to optimize processes and uncover opportunities for growth.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of analytics experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • 5+ years working with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • Strong ability to translate practical business problems into technical solutions.
  • Proven experience delivering time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, recommendations, and executive presentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in eCommerce or logistics industries.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience



About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.



About the Role


We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes


  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability


  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making


  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders


  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains




Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation


  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility


  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company


  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment


  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities:

- Configure switches and wireless access points.

- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.

- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.

- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.

- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.

- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary.

Qualifications:

- Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.

- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.

- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.

- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.

- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.

- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que

oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

  • Entendimento dos requisitos/necessidades das áreas de negócio; 
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog de desenvolvimento de forma a otimizar a execução das tarefas e os incrementos no produto; 
  • Acompanhar cronogramas e roadmaps, alinhado à expectativa dos clientes e usuários; 
  • Definir KPIs/OKRs específicos de produtos entregues e comunicar o monitoramento regular aos stakeholders; 
  • Trabalhar com o líder técnico para entender quais as entregas técnicas necessárias; 
  • Definir incrementos de valor na plataforma; 
  • Conduzir as demandas desde a sua identificação e planejamento até a sua efetiva aplicação; 
  • Escrever os requisitos de desenvolvimento e definir seus critérios de aceitação junto com o time; 
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento na execução e entrega das demandas, sempre buscando o alinhamento com o negócio e o produto; 
  • Participar de demonstrações do produto;  
  • Validar sistemas e soluções entregues pelo time desenvolvimento; 
  • Atuar junto com o líder técnico, identificando possíveis atrasos nas entregas e definindo mudanças de prioridades; 
  • Manter-se em constante atualização com as melhores práticas do mercado, trazendo sugestões e novas soluções. 

REQUISITOS 


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de produtos B2C; 
  • Experiência na escrita de requisitos de desenvolvimento de software; 
  • Experiência na gestão de backlog de desenvolvimento; 
  • Conhecimentos de técnicas de priorização do product backlog; 
  • Familiaridade com processos de discovery; 
  • Vivência em times de desenvolvimento ágil; 
  • Habilidade de negociação e relacionamento com desenvolvedores, usuários e partes interessadas; 
  • Background técnico na área de programação; 
  • Conhecimentos em Figma ou ferramentas similares; 


DIFERENCIAIS 


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções para maquininhas de pagamento; 
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções comerciais para o varejo e/ou marketplace; 
  • Conhecimento básicos de UX e UI; 
  • Certificação Product Owner (PSPO ou CSP);

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: Full Time

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate, commensurate with experience



About Design Manager

Design Manager (+DesignSpec) is a leading provider of project management and accounting software tailored specifically for interior design firms. For over 30 years, we’ve helped thousands of designers run more efficient, profitable businesses with our cloud-based platform that integrates purchasing, budgeting, time tracking, and client communication in one seamless solution. As we grow, we're investing heavily in our data infrastructure to enhance product capabilities and improve client outcomes.



About the Role


We’re seeking a skilled Data Engineer to support our product and technology team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines, analyzing data, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You'll be the first and only dedicated data analytics team member , so we’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable operating independently, defining structure, and solving complex data challenges.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes


  • Clean, validate, and structure raw data from various sources to ensure data quality and usability


  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decision-making


  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics to stakeholders


  • Work cross-functionally with teams (e.g., finance, operations, marketing) to define data needs and solve business problems using data


  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand and meet data requirements


  • Develop data models and schemas for analytics and reporting


  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability


  • Support the design and implementation of a modern data warehouse architecture


  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security best practices are followed


  • Work with third-party APIs and internal tools to extract, transform, and load data


  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial, self-starter attitude as the inaugural data analytics hire




Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field


  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or another scripting language


  • Experience analyzing large datasets and generating insights that drive business impact


  • Familiarity with dashboarding and analytics platforms such as Mode, Power BI, or similar


  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)


  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Fivetran) and data pipeline orchestration


  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and data modeling


  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills


  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal oversight




Nice to Have


  • Experience in SaaS or B2B software environments


  • Exposure to finance or accounting domains




Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly compensation


  • High-impact role with significant autonomy and visibility


  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of data and analytics at a growing SaaS company


  • Collaborative and mission-driven team environment


  • Possibility for contract extension or full-time conversion based on performance and business needs

title: Network Implementation Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Network Operations and Implementation Engineer – LAN/WLAN

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated L3 Network Engineer provide Level 3 network support and to implement LAN and WLAN infrastructure at sites across the North and South America. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CCNA certification, possess strong experience in configuring Cisco network switches and wireless access points, and can manage third-party wiring vendors effectively. This role requires a commitment to extensive travel, flexibility to work off-hours and weekends, and a focus on delivering high-quality network solutions in a dynamic environment. Trilingual in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities:

- Configure switches and wireless access points.

- Perform site assessments to evaluate current network infrastructure and develop action plans for equipment refresh.

- Work collaboratively with wiring vendors to oversee and ensure proper cabling and device installations and terminations meet project standards.

- Manage and troubleshoot network issues during the deployment and provide Level 3 hyper care support as needed.

- Document network configurations, topologies, and changes to maintain accurate records.

- Adhere to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

- Travel extensively (up to 25%) to various sites across South America, Mexico, the United States and Canada, including weekends and off-hours work as necessary.

Qualifications:

- Minimum Certification: CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) preferred.

- Proven experience in deploying and managing network devices, including Cisco and Juniper switches and wireless access points.

- Strong knowledge of LAN/WLAN networking protocols.

- Familiarity with cabling standards and experience managing wiring vendors.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced environments.

- Strong communication skills to interact effectively with team members, vendors, and stakeholders.

- Availability to travel internationally, extensively (up to 25%) and work weekends or during off-hours as required.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que

oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • Python (with strong data handling experience): ETL pipelines, familiarity with DataFrames (Pandas or similar)
  • PostgreSQL (loading, validation, filtering)
  • Familiarity with the AWS Cloud ecosystem
  • CI/CD and code hygiene for data pipelines
  • Machine Learning
  • Fluent English
  • An academic background (MSc or PhD) will also be a plus



As Contractor (PJ), you will have:


  • Competitive compensation (in Reais - R$)
  • Work with international clients with international standards
  • Opportunity to grow as a leader
  • Possibility to move between teams
  • Speak in English with your coworkers
  • 2 weeks of paid leave per year
  • National holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid marriage leave
  • Working with a company that cares about our people and their personal growth
  • All expenses paid for training, conferences, and online courses
  • Remote work
  • Health Care Plan - Online


If you are passionate about technology and have a strong desire to work on cutting-edge projects, we encourage you to apply for this position!


Submit your CV to make sure it contains your LinkedIn and GitHub accounts.

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A Exadel está procurando um Desenvolvedor Fullstack de Nível Intermediário (Java + Angular+ Quarkus) . Este profissional contribuirá tanto nas tarefas de desenvolvimento back-end quanto front-end, enquanto também desempenha um papel na garantia da qualidade do produto por meio de testes e validação. O foco será na entrega de recursos robustos, validação de integrações FIX, construção de interfaces de usuário e suporte a testes automatizados, tudo em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.


Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando Java + Quarkus no back-end e Angular no front-end. Entregar funcionalidades, correções de bugs e melhorias na interface com atenção ao desempenho e à usabilidade. Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, de integração, ponta a ponta). Garantir a qualidade do código e contribuir para manter uma alta cobertura de testes em toda a pilha. Colaborar em atividades de QA, validando tanto requisitos técnicos quanto de negócios. Fornecer suporte na resolução de problemas de aplicações em produção de baixa/média complexidade. Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, interagindo com equipes de negócios, produtos e tecnologia.


Experiência prática com Java 11+ e Quarkus (RESTEasy, Panache, MicroProfile). Conhecimento sólido de Angular para desenvolvimento front-end. Experiência básica a intermediária com o protocolo FIX. Experiência com JUnit, RestAssured ou outros frameworks de automação de testes. Compreensão de APIs REST e desenvolvimento de aplicações web. Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Familiaridade com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineers


Breakthrough Talent is currently supporting a leading data business build a brand new data platform to support a modern data mesh organisation. They work with national and global clients across data, software and digital consulting, and they are now looking for a Data Infrastructure Engineer to help build and scale their next generation platform.


This role suits someone who enjoys owning infrastructure, building reusable solutions, and supporting data teams with analytics and AI ready environments.


The Role


As a Data Engineer you will design, build and maintain the core infrastructure that enables data processing, analytics, data science and data management across the business.


You will work in a multi account and multi region AWS environment that follows zero trust and least privilege principles. Infrastructure as Code and CI CD will be central to how you operate, alongside continuous improvement and strong governance.


What You Will Do


  • Build and maintain cloud based infrastructure using Cloud Formation and SAM
  • Design and implement data processing environments using AWS services such as Glue, EMR, Sagemaker, Redshift, Aurora and Snowflake
  • Build data processing pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Spark, Lambda, Step Functions and Apache Airflow
  • Monitor performance, cost and security of the data platform
  • Apply strong data governance and access control for sensitive data
  • Collaborate with multiple teams to support the wider data platform strategy


What You Need


  • Six years or more experience in a Data Engineering or Data Infrastructure role
  • Strong experience building data architectures in AWS
  • Solid coding skills in Python and SQL, Golang
  • Strong Cloud Formation knowledge
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Postgres or Redshift
  • Good coding discipline including documentation, unit testing and version control
  • Experience with Git and CI CD tools such as GitLab
  • Worked in Agile teams and ceremonies
  • Strong problem solving skills and excellent communication


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Jira or similar project management tools
  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Spatial data processing experience


If you would like to learn more about the role, please reach out to Jake Denman at Breakthrough Talent.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Analista Cloud Azure - pleno/sênior | Comunicação em Espanhol fluente

Remoto (Brasil) ou Híbrido (SP/Região)


Buscamos um(a) especialista em Microsoft Azure com mentalidade DevOps/SRE e Espanhol avançado/fluente para atuar em projetos internacionais.

Será a peça-chave na sustentação e evolução de uma infraestrutura de nuvem crítica. Sua missão será garantir alta disponibilidade , otimizar custos e acelerar a entrega de valor através da automação.


Principais responsabilidades:


Você não será apenas um executor, mas um agente de transformação, colaborando globalmente.

Ser a referência na resolução de incidentes e problemas complexos no ambiente Azure.

Desenvolver, manter e aprimorar pipelines robustos no Azure DevOps, garantindo entregas rápidas e seguras.

Automatizar o provisionamento de recursos em escala utilizando Terraform.

Administrar e otimizar ambientes de Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes.

Gerenciar e aplicar práticas de FinOps para garantir a eficiência no consumo de recursos Azure.

Participar ativamente de discussões técnicas, documentação e suporte em Espanhol com times internacionais.


Requisitos essenciais:


Nossos filtros de seleção serão rigorosos para garantir o sucesso mútuo:

Obrigatório ter espanhol fluente/avançado para comunicação diária e reuniões com equipes de outros países.

Experiência sólida com Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS e Serverless).

Proficiência em Azure DevOps, Git e construção de pipelines de CI/CD.

Conhecimento prático e experiência com Terraform .

Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes .

Conhecimento em Linux e Windows Server .

Familiaridade com processos de ITIL/ITSM .

Formação superior completa em áreas de Tecnologia (ex: Ciência da Computação, Engenharia).


Diferenciais:

  • Possuir certificações técnicas Azure (Ex: AZ-104, AZ-400).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Ex: Datadog).
  • Habilidade de scripting (PowerShell, Bash ou Python).


***


Pacote de benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico de ponta.
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).
  • Seguro de Vida e Auxílio Creche.
  • Parcerias educacionais (idiomas e ensino superior).


Etapas do processo seletivo:

Bate-papo (RH): Alinhamento de perfil, expectativas e fit cultural/comportamental.

Entrevista técnica: Aprofundamento técnico e Teste Prático (se necessário) .


Modalidade de trabalho:

  • Full Remoto para candidatos de fora de São Paulo/Região.
  • Híbrido para São Paulo e arredores.

Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 8h às 17h.

title: Multidisciplinary Designer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa talentosa, experiente e comprometida para integrar nosso time.


Somos a commcepta, um estúdio de Design Management sediado em Curitiba com atuação global. Um time de talentos multidisciplinares com o propósito de superar a si mesmo a cada novo desafio. Somos membros, parte do Advisory Council e premiados pelo Design Management Institute (DMI), além de outras alianças estratégicas que somam conhecimento e reconhecem nossa atuação ao longo dos nossos mais de 25 anos. Mergulhamos fundo em pesquisa, conceituamos a solução para o problema e aplicamos Design em busca de um desenvolvimento sustentável, colaborativo e orgânico.


✏️ Sua função

Seu papel como Multidisciplinary Designer será somar na tradução daquilo que encontramos e validamos em pesquisa, conectados ao conceito central do projeto e integrados à estratégia do nosso cliente. Tudo isso alinhado ao nosso propósito de superar a nós mesmos em tudo o que fazemos.

A profundidade do nosso pensamento e a imersão no cliente são premissas do nosso trabalho. Primeiro, questionamos o problema, para depois buscar as possíveis soluções. Por isso, as possibilidades são múltiplas e permeiam todos os pontos de contato do público com a marca. A versatilidade do seu trabalho para elaborar diferentes materiais e sua habilidade em lidar com diversos segmentos contam muitos pontos para este papel.


✨ Nossas expectativas


Esperamos que todo(a) commcepter:

  • Traga novas ideias, some e vá além do “briefing”
  • Seja caprichoso, organizado e tenha atenção aos detalhes
  • Saiba ouvir e trabalhar colaborativamente
  • Concorde que design é mais do que layout e conceito não é “blá blá”
  • Goste de trabalhar com diferentes projetos, dos simples aos mais complexos
  • Busque aprender e se desenvolver com novas experiências e situações desafiadoras
  • Tenha uma visão ampla sem perder o foco nas operações do dia a dia
  • Seja comprometido e tenha vontade de crescer


Como Multidisciplinary Designer, esperamos que você:

  • Desenhe peças incríveis que deixem todo mundo orgulhoso
  • Seja hábil na criação de composições visualmente atraentes e cheias de significado
  • Seja inovador na criação de campanhas e comunicação de marca
  • Saiba conduzir uma boa pesquisa, conectando referências e autoridades do tema
  • Tenha um bom conhecimento do pacote Adobe (InDesign, Illustrator e Photoshop)
  • Tenha um nível de inglês intermediário para lidar com projetos globais


Especialidades desejadas:

  • Ter uma boa redação para a criação de chamadas e conteúdos
  • Ter habilidades de composição de storyboards e de animações / motion graphics
  • E/ou se interessar por UX-UI Design, saber criar e prototipar interfaces


Key Words: Multidisciplinary Design / Graphic Design / Brand Design / Visual Design / Brand Communication / Digital Design / Content Design / Design Research / Motion Design


Híbrido - Curitiba (Remote First)


É importante você saber que nossa forma de trabalho principal é remota, por isso contamos que você esteja disposto a trabalhar em casa. Buscamos pessoas que moram em Curitiba e região para encontros presenciais em nossa sede, quando necessário.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst


Role Summary

The FP&A Finance team is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support FP&A and month-end close activities across the Products FP&A team . This role requires a high degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and accountability to deadlines. Reporting to the Manager of Products FP&A , the analyst will be a key contributor across the broader FP&A organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and headcount analysis
  • Perform headcount reconciliation and reporting
  • Manage department expenses, including PO approval and tracking
  • Build and maintain financial models (Excel: intermediate to advanced)
  • Populate dashboards and KPI tools for data-driven decision-making
  • Monitor KPIs and analyze performance trends and drivers
  • Participate in monthly and quarterly close; prepare entries and reconciliations
  • Support global forecasting and budgeting for headcount and operational expenses
  • Conduct monthly variance analysis to ensure expenses are planned and justified
  • Prepare financial reporting for business partners (monthly, quarterly, ad hoc)
  • Perform margin analysis and automate manual reports in Excel and Hyperion
  • Provide general support for ad hoc projects and reporting requests
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering teams
  • Operate independently in a remote-first environment with proactive communication

Qualifications

Education : Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance (MBA preferred but not required)

  • Experience : 4–7+ years in FP&A, financial analysis, P&L modeling, and monthly close
  • Strong preference for experience supporting R&D, Engineering, or Product teams
  • Experience in multi-national, dynamic business environments
  • Technical Skills :
  • Advanced Excel modeling and automation
  • ERP systems (Oracle required), Hyperion reporting
  • Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint; Excel: intermediate to advanced)
  • Soft Skills :
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Detail-oriented with excellent time management and prioritization
  • Clear communicator with ability to present data simply and effectively
  • Team-oriented, self-starter, and comfortable working cross-functionally
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Maintains confidentiality with sensitive financial data

title: Multidisciplinary Designer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa talentosa, experiente e comprometida para integrar nosso time.


Somos a commcepta, um estúdio de Design Management sediado em Curitiba com atuação global. Um time de talentos multidisciplinares com o propósito de superar a si mesmo a cada novo desafio. Somos membros, parte do Advisory Council e premiados pelo Design Management Institute (DMI), além de outras alianças estratégicas que somam conhecimento e reconhecem nossa atuação ao longo dos nossos mais de 25 anos. Mergulhamos fundo em pesquisa, conceituamos a solução para o problema e aplicamos Design em busca de um desenvolvimento sustentável, colaborativo e orgânico.


✏️ Sua função

Seu papel como Multidisciplinary Designer será somar na tradução daquilo que encontramos e validamos em pesquisa, conectados ao conceito central do projeto e integrados à estratégia do nosso cliente. Tudo isso alinhado ao nosso propósito de superar a nós mesmos em tudo o que fazemos.

A profundidade do nosso pensamento e a imersão no cliente são premissas do nosso trabalho. Primeiro, questionamos o problema, para depois buscar as possíveis soluções. Por isso, as possibilidades são múltiplas e permeiam todos os pontos de contato do público com a marca. A versatilidade do seu trabalho para elaborar diferentes materiais e sua habilidade em lidar com diversos segmentos contam muitos pontos para este papel.


✨ Nossas expectativas


Esperamos que todo(a) commcepter:

  • Traga novas ideias, some e vá além do “briefing”
  • Seja caprichoso, organizado e tenha atenção aos detalhes
  • Saiba ouvir e trabalhar colaborativamente
  • Concorde que design é mais do que layout e conceito não é “blá blá”
  • Goste de trabalhar com diferentes projetos, dos simples aos mais complexos
  • Busque aprender e se desenvolver com novas experiências e situações desafiadoras
  • Tenha uma visão ampla sem perder o foco nas operações do dia a dia
  • Seja comprometido e tenha vontade de crescer


Como Multidisciplinary Designer, esperamos que você:

  • Desenhe peças incríveis que deixem todo mundo orgulhoso
  • Seja hábil na criação de composições visualmente atraentes e cheias de significado
  • Seja inovador na criação de campanhas e comunicação de marca
  • Saiba conduzir uma boa pesquisa, conectando referências e autoridades do tema
  • Tenha um bom conhecimento do pacote Adobe (InDesign, Illustrator e Photoshop)
  • Tenha um nível de inglês intermediário para lidar com projetos globais


Especialidades desejadas:

  • Ter uma boa redação para a criação de chamadas e conteúdos
  • Ter habilidades de composição de storyboards e de animações / motion graphics
  • E/ou se interessar por UX-UI Design, saber criar e prototipar interfaces


Key Words: Multidisciplinary Design / Graphic Design / Brand Design / Visual Design / Brand Communication / Digital Design / Content Design / Design Research / Motion Design


Híbrido - Curitiba (Remote First)


É importante você saber que nossa forma de trabalho principal é remota, por isso contamos que você esteja disposto a trabalhar em casa. Buscamos pessoas que moram em Curitiba e região para encontros presenciais em nossa sede, quando necessário.

title: Software Engineer (Murex)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Murex Developer to join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins as fully remote , with the expectation of relocation to Portugal after an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of the Murex MX.3 platform.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations within Murex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
  • Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and MxML Exchange interfaces.
  • Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
  • Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Murex MX.3 (configuration, development, or integration).
  • Solid knowledge of Datamart, MxML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
  • Strong programming skills: Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
  • Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Willingness and eligibility to relocate to Portugal after the initial remote period.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum .
  • Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.

Desired Profile

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
  • Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
  • Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.

What We Offer

  • Remote work during the initial phase.
  • Support and guidance for future relocation to Portugal .
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
  • Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A Exadel está procurando um Desenvolvedor Fullstack de Nível Intermediário (Java + Angular+ Quarkus) . Este profissional contribuirá tanto nas tarefas de desenvolvimento back-end quanto front-end, enquanto também desempenha um papel na garantia da qualidade do produto por meio de testes e validação. O foco será na entrega de recursos robustos, validação de integrações FIX, construção de interfaces de usuário e suporte a testes automatizados, tudo em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.


Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando Java + Quarkus no back-end e Angular no front-end. Entregar funcionalidades, correções de bugs e melhorias na interface com atenção ao desempenho e à usabilidade. Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, de integração, ponta a ponta). Garantir a qualidade do código e contribuir para manter uma alta cobertura de testes em toda a pilha. Colaborar em atividades de QA, validando tanto requisitos técnicos quanto de negócios. Fornecer suporte na resolução de problemas de aplicações em produção de baixa/média complexidade. Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, interagindo com equipes de negócios, produtos e tecnologia.


Experiência prática com Java 11+ e Quarkus (RESTEasy, Panache, MicroProfile). Conhecimento sólido de Angular para desenvolvimento front-end. Experiência básica a intermediária com o protocolo FIX. Experiência com JUnit, RestAssured ou outros frameworks de automação de testes. Compreensão de APIs REST e desenvolvimento de aplicações web. Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Familiaridade com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior "#983964"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento da área de Tecnologia.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados usando Spark, PySpark ou Scala no Databricks, garantindo automação e performance em processos ETL de grande volume;
  • Modelar, integrar e transformar dados complexos utilizando SQL avançado, assegurando qualidade e disponibilidade para áreas de negócio e analytics;
  • Criar e otimizar jobs em Spark para ingestão, limpeza, padronização e enriquecimento de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes;
  • Monitorar, documentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de dados, garantindo governança, escalabilidade, segurança e alto desempenho em ambientes de nuvem e plataformas como Databricks.

O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento de SQL e experiência com Databricks;
  • Familiaridade com Power BI e Tableau;
  • Proficiência em SQL e experiência prática com Databricks, Spark e Scala;
  • Experiência na criação de dashboards com Power BI;
  • Familiaridade com integração de jobs Spark para processos ETL;
  • Habilidades avançadas em SQL para manipulação e integração complexa de dados;
  • Expertise em Databricks, Spark, Scala e PySpark para engenharia de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência em Azure;
  • Experiência em mensageria (Kafka, Service Bus).


Qualificações

  • Bacharelado em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados ou funções relacionadas;
  • Experiência no setor financeiro/adquirência.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Regime de Contratação

CLT.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Control M;
  • Experiência prévia em Desenvolvimento Java;
  • Espanhol e Inglês.
