title: QA Analyst
description:
About TapGoods:


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent.

There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers.


Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve.


QA Analyst Role:

We are looking for a QA Analyst with a background in both manual and automated testing to join our development team. This role will be primarily responsible for manual testing at first, with an opportunity to shift into automation as we build out our test suite.

We have three web-based products built using Ruby on Rails and React. Our core product is a robust system with many complex features that will require the right person to fully ensure we are releasing the highest quality software.


Responsibilities:

●  Manual testing of new features

●  Manual regression testing of weekly releases

●  Working with the existing QA team on building out automated tests

●  Troubleshooting support issues


Requirements:

●  Experience with manual testing (2+ years)

●  Experience with automated testing (1+ years)

●  A great attitude and work ethic

●  Solution oriented, self-starter, and team player

●  (preferred) Experience in a SaaS company


Experience with the following technologies:

●  HTTP Protocol

●  Diff Tools (Beyond Compare, etc.)

●  Jira

●  Selenium

title: Analytics Engineer Sênior
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) / Analytics Engineer


A ATRA está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) para atuar na construção, organização e otimização de pipelines analíticos, modelos de transformação, governança de dados e camadas de consumo. Essa função combina engenharia, analytics e visão de produto — ideal para profissionais que transitam com fluidez entre dados, negócio e tecnologia.


Responsabilidades

  • Construir pipelines de transformação utilizando DBT com testes, documentação e boas práticas.
  • Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines complexos em Airflow.
  • Criar e otimizar estruturas em BigQuery com foco em performance e eficiência de custos.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e análises em Looker Platform, garantindo coerência entre métricas e modelos.
  • Atuar próximo a times de produto, dados e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções analíticas.
  • Garantir organização, padronização e governança das camadas de dados.
  • Automação de processos e validações utilizando Python (quando aplicável).
  • Acompanhar, investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados a dados e pipelines.
  • Documentar processos, modelos e padrões de forma clara e escalável.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a), Engenheiro(a) de BI ou função similar.
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, incluindo modelagem relacional e dimensional.
  • Experiência avançada com DBT para construção e gestão de pipelines de transformação.
  • Experiência com Airflow para orquestração de fluxos de dados.
  • GCP – BigQuery : conhecimento profundo de performance, otimização de custos e recursos avançados.
  • Familiaridade com serviços de dados do GCP (ex.: Cloud Storage).
  • Experiência com Looker Platform para criação de dashboards e análises.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis/Consultivos)

  • Perfil consultivo: capacidade de dialogar com áreas não técnicas e traduzir necessidades em soluções.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade para análise de causa-raiz e construção de insights.
  • Cultura forte de documentação, governança e padronização de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python para automações e análises exploratórias.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de negócio (Opcional): AARRR, LTV, CAC, métricas financeiras.


Soft Skills

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização, autonomia e alto rigor técnico.
  • Visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Proatividade para propor melhorias estruturais.


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido ou Remoto (ajustável conforme projeto)


Benefícios ATRA

  • TotalPass
  • Reembolso 100% em certificações
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA: Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and onboard world-class creative and production talent. You’ll help build the global network that powers SoCreative — sourcing videographers, photographers, designers, editors, motion specialists, creative leads, project managers, and other key roles across time zones.


This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys connecting great people with great opportunities. If you’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and love building strong talent pipelines, you’ll thrive here.


What you’ll do

  • Source and attract top creative, production, and operations talent across global markets
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle — from job posting to screening, interviews, assessments, and onboarding
  • Build strong talent pools for high-demand roles (design, video, motion, PM, creative leads)
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and refine talent profiles
  • Conduct structured interviews and evaluate candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit
  • Maintain organised, up-to-date applicant pipelines and recruitment dashboards
  • Implement scalable sourcing strategies using LinkedIn, job boards, communities, referrals, and outreach tools
  • Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates to ensure a positive experience
  • Help improve hiring processes, documentation, and workflows as we grow


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or sourcing (creative, agency, or tech experience preferred)
  • Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with modern recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, etc.)
  • Ability to assess creative and operational talent across multiple specialties
  • Clear and confident communication in English, able to manage candidate expectations and present opportunities effectively
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple roles at once

Com uma presença internacional em 25 países a Prosegur, proporciona às empresas e lares, uma segurança de confiança baseada nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado.

Valorizamos e incentivamos o conhecimento técnico e a capacidade de inovar de Nossa Gente e acreditamos que assim é possível atingir nosso propósito de tornar o mundo mais seguro para todos.

Se você se identifica com o nosso negócio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time e acelerar sua carreira.


Quais são os desafios?

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações de APIs em Python e Node.js (REST/GraphQL, webhooks, SDKs).
  • Construir conectores para ferramentas de segurança (ex.: autenticação/identidade, gerenciamento de acessos, WAF, SIEM, EDR) e sistemas corporativos (ERP, CRM, ITSM).
  • Implementar automatizações de processos (jobs, schedulers, filas).
  • Garantir observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing) e qualidade (testes unitários/integrados, cobertura).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança em integrações (auth, tokens, secrets, criptografia em trânsito/repouso).
  • Trabalhar em squads ágeis : participar de plano de sprint , daily , reviews e retros ; colaborar na refinação de histórias e estimativas.
  • Participar de code reviews , documentar integrações (README, OpenAPI/Swagger).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de APIs e integrações em Python (FastAPI/Flask) e Node.js (Express/NestJS).
  • Experiência com versionamento (Git) e CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps).
  • Prática com testes automatizados e documentação de APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Atuação em Scrum ou Kanban , com participação ativa em dailies, planning, review e retro .
  • Colaboração em code reviews , pair programming e definição de padrões (linters, convenções, documentação).
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação / Segurança da Informação e afins;



Diferenciais:

  • Integrações com ferramentas de segurança (ex.: Identity & Access, PAM, Firewalls, EDR, WAF/CDN, CASB, etc).
  • Experiência em cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers (Docker) e Infra-as-Code (Terraform).
  • Conhecimento de GraphQL , gRPC , serverless (Lambda/Cloud Functions).
  • Prática com observabilidade (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Opensearch, OpenTelemetry).
  • Noções de segurança de software (OWASP Top 10, secure coding).


O que oferecemos a você?


Na Cipher nosso beneficio é flexível VR/VA - Flash


Auxilio Home Office, para dar uma força adicional aos gastos do mês, já que estará trabalhando de casa na maior parte do tempo.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- Experiência sólida com Python;

- Experiência com Java e Quarkus;

- Conhecimento em JavaScript + Angular;

- Vivência com OCR (processamento e leitura de documentos);

- Uso de Docker para empacotamento e deploy;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados;

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:

title: QA Analyst
description:
About TapGoods:


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent.

There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers.


Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve.


QA Analyst Role:

We are looking for a QA Analyst with a background in both manual and automated testing to join our development team. This role will be primarily responsible for manual testing at first, with an opportunity to shift into automation as we build out our test suite.

We have three web-based products built using Ruby on Rails and React. Our core product is a robust system with many complex features that will require the right person to fully ensure we are releasing the highest quality software.


Responsibilities:

●  Manual testing of new features

●  Manual regression testing of weekly releases

●  Working with the existing QA team on building out automated tests

●  Troubleshooting support issues


Requirements:

●  Experience with manual testing (2+ years)

●  Experience with automated testing (1+ years)

●  A great attitude and work ethic

●  Solution oriented, self-starter, and team player

●  (preferred) Experience in a SaaS company


Experience with the following technologies:

●  HTTP Protocol

●  Diff Tools (Beyond Compare, etc.)

●  Jira

●  Selenium

Brasil

#VemSerOC

Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.


Aqui na Oncoclinicas&CO valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

Profissional responsável em apoiar na elaboração de estratégias de recrutamento de pacientes potenciais participantes de pesquisa, busca ativa, referenciamento e contrarreferenciamento e avaliação da elegibilidade desses potenciais pacientes.

Formação superior completa na área da saúde;

Experiência no recrutamento de pacientes para pesquisa clínica;

Bom conhecimento em protocolos de pesquisa clínica;

Vivência com IWRS, CRFs;

Disponibilidade para viagens;

Inglês intermediário.

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas


Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos o CLUDE SAÚDE – uma central de saúde que oferece telepsicologia, orientação médica, nutricional, acompanhamento do pré-natal de gestantes e teleatendimento médico.


Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.


Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO e para ajudar nas compras do mês, um VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO.


Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.


E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.


No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.


E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nosso PROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.

E faça parte do time de pessoas extraordinárias que atuam com a missão de vencer o câncer!

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)


Type: Full-Time


About Indigo Beam

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.


Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.


Project Management:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.


Microsoft DevOps Project Management:

  • Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
  • Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.


Business Analysis:

  • Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.


Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.


Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.


Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Informations:

  • Type of Contract: PJ
  • Hours: Full-time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Duration: Long-term

title: Especialista Engenharia Mobile (React Native)
description:
Organização de grande porte busca profissional com sólida experiência técnica para liderar uma equipe de desenvolvimento focada em aplicações móveis React Native. O desafio envolve atuar como referência técnica, direcionando o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades estratégicas e promovendo a excelência do produto. O ambiente é dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir arquitetura e padrões de desenvolvimento para aplicações React Native, assegurando qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Orientar e desenvolver o time técnico, promovendo crescimento profissional e colaboração.
  • Interagir com outras áreas para garantir entregas eficazes e seguras.
  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurando aderência a padrões, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar na gestão de projetos, estimando prazos, acompanhando progresso e removendo obstáculos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento mobile, com foco em React Native.
  • Domínio de JavaScript, TypeScript e fundamentos de front-end.
  • Vivência com APIs RESTful e integrações back-end.
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança para desenvolvimento mobile (OWASP Mobile Top Ten).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise estática e dinâmica de código (SAST/DAST).
  • Atuação com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em NodeJS.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo Android (Java/Kotlin) ou iOS (Swift/Objective-C).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Vivência em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Contribuições para projetos open-source.


Comportamentais:

  • Liderança colaborativa e inspiradora.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva.
  • Respeito à diversidade e postura ética.
  • Humildade e responsabilidade.

title: PESSOA REDATORA SÊNIOR - VAGA AFIRMATIVA
description:
PESSOA REDATORA SÊNIOR ** VAGA AFIRMATIVA EXCLUSIVA PESSOAS NEGRAS, PARDAS e INDÍGENAS**

Área de atuação: Comunicação Interna & Publicidade 


Sobre diversidade

Na DALE, valorizamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo. Acreditamos que diferentes trajetórias geram ideias mais criativas e soluções mais potentes, além de fortalecer um ambiente com repertório sociocultural ampliado. Incentivamos fortemente candidaturas de pessoas negras, pardas, indígenas, mulheres, pessoas LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência e 50+.


Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa redatora sênior capaz de transitar com fluidez entre comunicação interna e publicidade. Procuramos alguém com repertório jornalístico, domínio de copy e desenvolvimento de conceitos, confortável em atender vários clientes e articular entregas com criação, conteúdo e planejamento.


Objetivo

Ser a referência editorial e estratégica dos clientes da DALE: levantar e refinar briefings, apurar e organizar informações (tom jornalístico), transformar em narrativas claras e persuasivas para públicos internos e externos, garantir consistência de tom de voz e qualidade das entregas de ponta a ponta.


O que você vai fazer (principais responsabilidades)


  • Comunicação interna: comunicados, canais internos, redes sociais corporativas, intranet, campanhas de endomarketing, manuais e guias, newsletters internas, roteiros de vídeo e apresentações.


  • Marketing digital comunicação externa: calendários editoriais, copies para redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram, etc.), roteiros, landing pages, e-mail marketing, anúncios (hooks, CTAs) e cases.


  • Conduzir entrevistas e apurações com stakeholders; transformar insumos técnicos em linguagem acessível.


  • Criar conceitos criativos (tanto internos quanto externos), defender racional e garantir aderência à estratégia do cliente.



O que buscamos?

  • Formação em Jornalismo, Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência comprovada como pessoa redatora sênior (portfólio com peças de CI e de marketing digital).


  • Português impecável (clareza, coerência, revisão final) e capacidade de adaptação de tom de voz.


  • Vivência em comunicação interna (canais, endomarketing, executivos, cultura).


  • Vivência em social media/marketing digital (copy, funil, SEO básico, UX writing desejável).


  • Organização, senso de prioridade e excelente relacionamento interpessoal com times e clientes.


  • Inglês: intermediário ou avançado (desejável).



Como funciona? 

Local de trabalho: remoto.

Horário: comercial (9h–18h).

Contratação: PJ.

Faixa salarial: R$ 6.000,00.


Benefícios: 

VR R$ 30,00

Plano de Saúde

Plano Odontológico

Seguro de Vida

Totalpass

Licenças estendidas (maternidade 6 meses | paternidade 20 dias) 

Day off de aniversário

title: Linguist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

title: Researcher
description:
Join Bentham Science Publishers as a Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal , "Current Organic Chemistry"


If you're interested in publishing your Research, click here.



Position Overview:

We invite researchers and scientists to join us as Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal,

"Current Organic Chemistry" , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise.


The candidates for the Guest Topical Issue Editor position should have a proven track record of scholarly publishing and organizing a Topical Issue, and they should be able to assemble a collection of high-quality research/review articles related to their section.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing a comprehensive proposal for a special issue, highlighting its importance and detailing prospective contributors.
  • Collaborating with possible co-editors to effectively organize the special issue and coordinate with authors, ensuring a smooth editorial process.
  • Inviting contributors from diverse regions, focusing on those with a proven publication record.
  • Promoting the special issue to enhance its visibility and impact.


*The Article Processing Charges (APC) are offered with a discount to facilitate Open Access publishing by the authors.


Qualifications and Experience:

• Ph.D. in related fields

• A valid Scopus ID.

• Prior experience in publishing guest-edited thematic issues in peer-reviewed journals.

• They must have a list of scholarly authors who can consent to contribute research / review articles in the thematic issue(s) proposed by the Topical Issue.

• Strong networks within the research community.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with scientific publication and peer review processes.


Benefits:

• An honorarium to support thematic issue promotion and academic & research endeavors.

• Rapid publication of the special issue, with articles going online within 30 days of acceptance.

• Full APC waiver for an article authored by the Topical Issue.

• A free online subscription to all articles published in the journal during the year.


Location:

This is a remote opportunity, offering flexibility and convenience.


How To Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 December 2025. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines.


Special Instructions:

• Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue.

• Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief.

• Manuscript submission extensions will be limited to 60 days.


Additional Offer:

In our ongoing efforts to expand our Editorial team, we are pleased to offer the successful Guest Editors a potential for advancement within the Editorial Board. Based on qualifications and contributions, outstanding editors may be considered for prestigious positions on our Editorial Board.


*The provision of Scopus ID is a MUST for the application to be shortlisted.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and onboard world-class creative and production talent. You’ll help build the global network that powers SoCreative — sourcing videographers, photographers, designers, editors, motion specialists, creative leads, project managers, and other key roles across time zones.


This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys connecting great people with great opportunities. If you’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and love building strong talent pipelines, you’ll thrive here.


What you’ll do

  • Source and attract top creative, production, and operations talent across global markets
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle — from job posting to screening, interviews, assessments, and onboarding
  • Build strong talent pools for high-demand roles (design, video, motion, PM, creative leads)
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and refine talent profiles
  • Conduct structured interviews and evaluate candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit
  • Maintain organised, up-to-date applicant pipelines and recruitment dashboards
  • Implement scalable sourcing strategies using LinkedIn, job boards, communities, referrals, and outreach tools
  • Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates to ensure a positive experience
  • Help improve hiring processes, documentation, and workflows as we grow


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or sourcing (creative, agency, or tech experience preferred)
  • Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with modern recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, etc.)
  • Ability to assess creative and operational talent across multiple specialties
  • Clear and confident communication in English, able to manage candidate expectations and present opportunities effectively
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple roles at once
  • A positive, collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility — powered by smart tech, streamlined systems, and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking, and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative, and help shape a modern creative operation — we’d love to hear from you!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Job Title: Graphic Designer

Our client is looking for a Graphic Designer to support their growing creative needs and help uphold the visual quality of the brand.

There are two divisions - men’s and women’s - and the designer should be able to adapt their style to different brand directions. The men’s division is shifting toward a more futuristic style described as “digital mesh, light orbs,” and the designer should be able to align with that direction using existing brand guides.

  • Proficient in Figma, including creating wireframes/layouts for landing pages.

  • Ability to uphold brand quality standards.

title: PPC Analyst
description:
PPC Analyst (Full-Time – Remote from Brazil)


Please make sure to submit your resume in English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be accepted. The interview process will also be conducted in English.


Smart Age Solutions is a Digital Marketing agency located in New York with a branch in Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for new talents in Brazil who would like to build a career at an American Company!

Here at Smart Age, we offer a wide range of results-driven services and don’t settle for less-than-optimum quality. Smart Age is the only Google Premier Partner and META Preferred Partner in the jewelry industry. We create precise, fully customizable strategies across Google Search, Social Media, SEO, Retargeting, Display, and Email Marketing to maximize conversions. Our team of industry experts helps businesses succeed in an increasingly digital world by using practices and platforms that deliver results today while planning for what’s coming tomorrow.


Job Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled and results-oriented PPC Analyst to join our Paid Media team. This is a full-time, remote position for professionals based in Brazil.

In this role, you will be responsible for creating, managing, and optimizing Paid Media campaigns across multiple platforms including Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max) and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram). You will collaborate closely with our Account Management team to ensure client success through data-driven strategy and precise execution.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and has a strong analytical mindset, solid communication skills, and a deep understanding of digital advertising platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads for a variety of clients.
  • Manage campaign budgets, bids, and pacing to ensure KPIs and goals are met.
  • Analyze campaign data and performance metrics to generate actionable insights.
  • Produce monthly performance reports and collaborate with Account Managers on strategic recommendations.
  • Monitor trends, updates, and best practices in Paid Media to ensure campaign efficiency.
  • Provide strategic input to improve overall account performance and growth.
  • Ensure tracking and attribution are properly implemented using Google Analytics 4 and/or Google Tag Manager.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with Google Ads, including Search, Display, Remarketing, Shopping, and/or Performance Max campaigns.
  • Proven experience managing paid campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency with data and reporting tools.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) with strong communication skills.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to align digital campaigns with business goals.


Tools You Will Use:

  • Google Ads
  • Facebook Business Manager
  • Google Analytics 4
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Looker Studio (Google Data Studio)
  • Google Sheets / Excel

Job Details:

  • Type: Full-Time, Remote
  • Location: Brazil-based
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (BRT)
  • Compensation: Based on experience


Join us in shaping the future of global digital innovation! We embrace diversity and inclusion, valuing talent and passion above all else. Don’t miss out on this exciting opportunity to lead strategic marketing initiatives and help expand Smart Age’s reach in the luxury digital space. Apply now and let’s grow together!

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Mobility Care Associate


Job Type: Full-time, Overnight Freelancer Position

Location: Remote - Brazil - Work from home

Hours: Set Schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


**** This schedule is set and will not change ****


**** Resumes must be submitted in English ****


On behalf of our client, we are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with excellent communication skills to join the Mindglobal team as a Mobility Care Associate .

Mindglobal , listed in Gartner's 2021 Market Guide, offers corporate TEM (Telecom Expense Management) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises around the world. They are adding new members to their Brazilian team.


Position Overview

As a Mobility Care Associate for Mindglobal , you are responsible for providing customer and technical assistance and support related to mobile device systems, hardware, software, company and carrier processes, and client procedures. You will respond to queries by inbound phone call, email and as assigned, respond in a timely and professional manner, isolate issues and requests, and determine and implement a resolution as per client specific company procedures.


This position is responsible for general customer service and completion of our clients’ day-to-day tasks within measurable SLA metrics.


What you'll do:

  • Quickly and professionally answer inbound client calls according to each client’s preferred greeting and nomenclature
  • Respond to requests for assistance sent by email and received by our Helpdesk Ticketing solution professionally and using appropriate templates, verbiage and guidelines, and within each client’s desired response SLA
  • Understand, access, and efficiently use carrier portals and other tools
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported hardware, Mindglobal tools and carrier systems
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported MDM and related systems, Mindglobal published client- and inside-facing tools, and carrier portals
  • Research process, policy and procedure questions using available informational resources
  • Using appropriate and professional grammar and communication skills, advise client employees on appropriate action(s), timelines, outcomes, etc.
  • Follow Mindglobal’s standard help desk procedures according to each client’s agreements, preferences and processes as noted in the KB, and as may be advised by MCM/CM and Helpdesk management
  • Ensure 100% of your client-related work is entered, tracked and documented in our Helpdesk Ticketing system correctly
  • Provide guidance to clients’ employees on proper use of Mindglobal specific websites and tools
  • Understand and explain client-specific processes and procedures as well as carrier specific data to clients’ employees
  • Refer and redirect non-Helpdesk requests to appropriate resource(s)
  • Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC/Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal’s purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal’s electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal’s purposes


Who you are:

  • Proficient and professional/native level English speaker and writer
  • Able to multi-task and juggle a large volume of tasks
  • Consistently reliable: able to be on time and present when scheduled
  • Professional behavior in the workplace, remotely, and anywhere your Mindglobal affiliation is known
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written
  • Self-motivated to be effective with minimal supervision
  • Detail, process and results oriented
  • Ability to avoid distraction and consistently work throughout a scheduled shift
  • Previous experience in mobile/wireless industry a plus


What Mindglobal offers:

  • Career Growth – Mindglobal prioritizes internal promotions.
  • Remote Flexibility – Work from home in Brazil.
  • Company Culture – A collaborative and supportive team environment.


Job Type: Full-time, Contract position

This is a freelancer position. Benefits (such as healthcare, paid time off or 13th month pay) are not provided. You will be an independent direct contractor ("freelancer") with Mindglobal and paid hourly for time worked. You will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week and as a contractor can choose your time off and holidays.


Compensation & Hours:

Pay: $6.60 USD per hour - This amount of hourly pay is only associated with this “overnight” shift as it includes an overnight pay differential.


Hours: Set schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas


Idioma:

  • English (Obrigatório)

title: US Immigration Consultant
description:
Reporting to: Founders


Company Description


Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform created by immigrants to support the U.S. mobility needs of technologists, artists, and skilled professionals.


Our mission is to streamline the immigration process using innovative tools and resources to empower global talent. Beyond Border is dedicated to fostering inclusivity, bridging gaps, and making global career transitions as seamless as possible.


Our first product is to help tech operators and founders navigate U.S. immigration with ease. We work with Founders and skilled executives to make their U.S. immigration journey seamless.


We are profitable, and are trusted by clients hailing from Microsoft, Google, Meta, Amazon, Klarna, Chime and more.

The US Immigration Consultant role is a full cycle sales role from prospecting to closing.


You should have at least 1 year of experience working in US high skilled immigration pathways, including O-1, L-1, EB-1 or EB2-NIW categories.


Legal professionals who have a track record of managing client intakes are welcomed to apply as well.


You will be working with a seasoned operator team that has experience building businesses from Seed to IPO, hailing from Wework, Glints, Square Peg, Apps For Bharat, Solifi and Line Data before.


Qualifications

  • You must have at least 1+ year of US immigration experience, OR
  • You must have managed B2C sales before with a track record of surpassing quota for at least 4 consecutive quarters

title: Researcher
description:
Join Bentham Science Publishers as a Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal , "Current Organic Chemistry"


If you're interested in publishing your Research, click here.



Position Overview:

We invite researchers and scientists to join us as Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal,

"Current Organic Chemistry" , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise.


The candidates for the Guest Topical Issue Editor position should have a proven track record of scholarly publishing and organizing a Topical Issue, and they should be able to assemble a collection of high-quality research/review articles related to their section.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing a comprehensive proposal for a special issue, highlighting its importance and detailing prospective contributors.
  • Collaborating with possible co-editors to effectively organize the special issue and coordinate with authors, ensuring a smooth editorial process.
  • Inviting contributors from diverse regions, focusing on those with a proven publication record.
  • Promoting the special issue to enhance its visibility and impact.


*The Article Processing Charges (APC) are offered with a discount to facilitate Open Access publishing by the authors.


Qualifications and Experience:

• Ph.D. in related fields

• A valid Scopus ID.

• Prior experience in publishing guest-edited thematic issues in peer-reviewed journals.

• They must have a list of scholarly authors who can consent to contribute research / review articles in the thematic issue(s) proposed by the Topical Issue.

• Strong networks within the research community.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with scientific publication and peer review processes.


Benefits:

• An honorarium to support thematic issue promotion and academic & research endeavors.

• Rapid publication of the special issue, with articles going online within 30 days of acceptance.

• Full APC waiver for an article authored by the Topical Issue.

• A free online subscription to all articles published in the journal during the year.


Location:

This is a remote opportunity, offering flexibility and convenience.


How To Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 December 2025. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines.


Special Instructions:

• Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue.

• Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief.

• Manuscript submission extensions will be limited to 60 days.


Additional Offer:

In our ongoing efforts to expand our Editorial team, we are pleased to offer the successful Guest Editors a potential for advancement within the Editorial Board. Based on qualifications and contributions, outstanding editors may be considered for prestigious positions on our Editorial Board.


*The provision of Scopus ID is a MUST for the application to be shortlisted.

title: Desenvolvedor de Integrações (APIs)
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos a Cipher, uma empresa do grupo Prosegur especializada em Cibersegurança. A Prosegur é líder global no setor em serviços integrados de segurança (vigilância e tecnologia corporativa), monitoramento de alarmes, transporte de valores. Com uma presença internacional em 25 países a Prosegur, proporciona às empresas e lares, uma segurança de confiança baseada nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado.

Valorizamos e incentivamos o conhecimento técnico e a capacidade de inovar de Nossa Gente e acreditamos que assim é possível atingir nosso propósito de tornar o mundo mais seguro para todos.

Se você se identifica com o nosso negócio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time e acelerar sua carreira.


Quais são os desafios?

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações de APIs em Python e Node.js (REST/GraphQL, webhooks, SDKs).
  • Construir conectores para ferramentas de segurança (ex.: autenticação/identidade, gerenciamento de acessos, WAF, SIEM, EDR) e sistemas corporativos (ERP, CRM, ITSM).
  • Implementar automatizações de processos (jobs, schedulers, filas).
  • Garantir observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing) e qualidade (testes unitários/integrados, cobertura).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança em integrações (auth, tokens, secrets, criptografia em trânsito/repouso).
  • Trabalhar em squads ágeis : participar de plano de sprint , daily , reviews e retros ; colaborar na refinação de histórias e estimativas.
  • Participar de code reviews , documentar integrações (README, OpenAPI/Swagger).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de APIs e integrações em Python (FastAPI/Flask) e Node.js (Express/NestJS).
  • Experiência com versionamento (Git) e CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps).
  • Prática com testes automatizados e documentação de APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Atuação em Scrum ou Kanban , com participação ativa em dailies, planning, review e retro .
  • Colaboração em code reviews , pair programming e definição de padrões (linters, convenções, documentação).
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação / Segurança da Informação e afins;



Diferenciais:

  • Integrações com ferramentas de segurança (ex.: Identity & Access, PAM, Firewalls, EDR, WAF/CDN, CASB, etc).
  • Experiência em cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers (Docker) e Infra-as-Code (Terraform).
  • Conhecimento de GraphQL , gRPC , serverless (Lambda/Cloud Functions).
  • Prática com observabilidade (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Opensearch, OpenTelemetry).
  • Noções de segurança de software (OWASP Top 10, secure coding).


O que oferecemos a você?


Na Cipher nosso beneficio é flexível VR/VA - Flash


Auxilio Home Office, para dar uma força adicional aos gastos do mês, já que estará trabalhando de casa na maior parte do tempo.

title: Test Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Monetary Metals® is a high-growth company at the intersection of precious metals and finance. The company provides a platform for investors to earn interest on gold and silver while offering financing to precious metals businesses. Our mission is to unlock the productivity of gold and silver, enabling a return to sound money principles in the modern economy.


Position Overview

Monetary Metals (MM) is a disruptive, high-growth gold platform that pays interest to savers, finances qualified businesses, and provides a liquid marketplace for gold leases and bonds. We are looking for an individual who is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing systems that ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of Monetary Metals’ technology platform. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with a talented engineering team to strengthen software quality, testing culture, and deployment confidence across multiple systems.

title: Researcher
description:
Join Bentham Science Publishers as a Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal , "Current Organic Chemistry"


If you're interested in publishing your Research, click here.



Position Overview:

We invite researchers and scientists to join us as Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal,

"Current Organic Chemistry" , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise.


The candidates for the Guest Topical Issue Editor position should have a proven track record of scholarly publishing and organizing a Topical Issue, and they should be able to assemble a collection of high-quality research/review articles related to their section.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing a comprehensive proposal for a special issue, highlighting its importance and detailing prospective contributors.
  • Collaborating with possible co-editors to effectively organize the special issue and coordinate with authors, ensuring a smooth editorial process.
  • Inviting contributors from diverse regions, focusing on those with a proven publication record.
  • Promoting the special issue to enhance its visibility and impact.


*The Article Processing Charges (APC) are offered with a discount to facilitate Open Access publishing by the authors.


Qualifications and Experience:

• Ph.D. in related fields

• A valid Scopus ID.

• Prior experience in publishing guest-edited thematic issues in peer-reviewed journals.

• They must have a list of scholarly authors who can consent to contribute research / review articles in the thematic issue(s) proposed by the Topical Issue.

• Strong networks within the research community.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with scientific publication and peer review processes.


Benefits:

• An honorarium to support thematic issue promotion and academic & research endeavors.

• Rapid publication of the special issue, with articles going online within 30 days of acceptance.

• Full APC waiver for an article authored by the Topical Issue.

• A free online subscription to all articles published in the journal during the year.


Location:

This is a remote opportunity, offering flexibility and convenience.


How To Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 December 2025. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines.


Special Instructions:

• Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue.

• Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief.

• Manuscript submission extensions will be limited to 60 days.


Additional Offer:

In our ongoing efforts to expand our Editorial team, we are pleased to offer the successful Guest Editors a potential for advancement within the Editorial Board. Based on qualifications and contributions, outstanding editors may be considered for prestigious positions on our Editorial Board.


*The provision of Scopus ID is a MUST for the application to be shortlisted.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. Supporting internal engineering teams across the enterprise, you’ll contribute to a mature and rapidly expanding initiative driving Continuous Delivery Release Orchestration (CDRO) adoption - powering over 100+ applications and accelerating delivery excellence for teams primarily across the United States.


This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.


Your Role as a DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams
  • Work closely with Senior Engineers to execute release orchestration onboarding tasks
  • Assist in scaling the enterprise adoption of CloudBees RO, Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD
  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)
  • Support SAST/DAST integration within secure delivery pipelines
  • Provide technical support to internal teams as they adopt enterprise DevOps tooling
  • Contribute to IaC and automation efforts using Python and Ansible Automation Platform
  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes
  • Ensure accurate documentation, repeatable execution, and alignment to engineering guidelines


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of DevOps engineering experience
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD/RO tooling: Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD/RO, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)
  • Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision
  • CloudBees RO experience is highly preferred


Why Join the Remobi Community

  • 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts
  • Access to a global network of top-tier engineering opportunities
  • Curated content, role alerts, and a supportive contractor community


Apply today: If you're ready to elevate software delivery excellence at scale and support a global CDRO transformation initiative - we want to hear from you!

description:
About the company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to join our team.


Responsibilities

  • Deployment of automated compliance controls via selected Conformance Packs.

  • All Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) artifacts (Terraform/CloudFormation templates).



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. title: Designer de experiência do usuário
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa curiosa, com olhar para experiência do usuário e vontade de aprender na prática, a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) UX/UI Designer Júnior para reforçar nossa área de Produto e UX.

Você será responsável por criar wireframes, fluxos e telas , ajudando a dar mais vazão aos projetos dos produtos da LET’S (como Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.). Vai atuar sempre orientado(a) pelos gestores do time , transformando problemas e requisitos em experiências digitais mais claras, intuitivas e fáceis de usar.


É uma vaga ideal para quem está no início da carreira em UX/UI, gosta de entender jornadas, organizar informação, desenhar telas e quer aprender diretamente com pessoas mais experientes, participando do ciclo completo de produto: discovery, definição, prototipação e handoff para desenvolvimento.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Apoiar na estruturação de fluxos e jornadas do usuário dentro dos produtos da LET’S.
  • Criar wireframes de baixa e média fidelidade (em Figma ou similar) a partir de problemas, briefings e requisitos definidos pelo time.
  • Desenhar layouts de telas e componentes de interface , seguindo o design system e as diretrizes visuais da LET’S.
  • Ajudar a transformar funcionalidades complexas em interfaces simples e objetivas para o usuário final (lojistas, operadores logísticos, entregadores, etc.).
  • Construir protótipos navegáveis para validação interna e com usuários (quando aplicável).
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com Produto, Tech e stakeholders, entendendo contexto e necessidades.
  • Organizar e documentar decisões de UX/UI , fluxos e componentes para facilitar a vida de devs e de outras pessoas do time.
  • Apoiar na manutenção e evolução do design system , ajudando a manter consistência entre os diferentes produtos.
  • Buscar referências, boas práticas e exemplos de UX/UI para inspirar soluções melhores.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência prévia em UX/UI (pode ser estágio, projetos acadêmicos, freelas ou autorais) com portfólio que mostre seu raciocínio de design.
  • Conhecimento básico/intermediário em Figma (ou ferramenta similar) para criação de wireframes, protótipos e interfaces.
  • Noções sólidas de fundamentos de UX : hierarquia de informação, usabilidade, navegação, feedback ao usuário.
  • Noções de UI e design visual : tipografia, espaçamento, alinhamento, contrastes, componentes.
  • Interesse real em trabalhar com produto digital B2B/SaaS (nada de “só layout bonito”: aqui a experiência tem impacto direto no negócio).
  • Vontade de aprender, ouvir feedback, iterar e trabalhar em equipe.
  • Capacidade de comunicar ideias de forma clara , tanto visualmente quanto falando/escrevendo.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com testes de usabilidade (mesmo que simples, acadêmicos ou em projetos pessoais).
  • Noções de HTML/CSS (para entender melhor as limitações e possibilidades na hora de desenhar telas).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de prototipação e handoff (Figma, FigJam, Zeplin, etc.).
  • Experiência ou interesse em produtos B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile .
  • Noções básicas de métricas de produto (ex.: adoção de funcionalidade, engajamento, conversão em fluxos).
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário para consumir material de referência.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


Como se destacar:

Ao se candidatar, envie seu portfólio , mesmo que com projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais, mostrando:

  • Processo , não só telas prontas: problema, contexto, alternativas que você considerou e por que escolheu a solução final.
  • Wireframes e fluxos : como você organiza a informação e constrói a navegação.
  • Exemplos de interfaces em que você aplicou boas práticas de UX/UI (mesmo que não estejam “perfeitas”).
  • Uma breve explicação de como você aprende (cursos, estudos, testes, referências) e como lida com feedback para melhorar seu trabalho.

title: Researcher
description:
Join Bentham Science Publishers as a Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal , "Current Organic Chemistry"


If you're interested in publishing your Research, click here.



Position Overview:

We invite researchers and scientists to join us as Guest Topical Issue Editor for the journal,

"Current Organic Chemistry" , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise.


The candidates for the Guest Topical Issue Editor position should have a proven track record of scholarly publishing and organizing a Topical Issue, and they should be able to assemble a collection of high-quality research/review articles related to their section.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing a comprehensive proposal for a special issue, highlighting its importance and detailing prospective contributors.
  • Collaborating with possible co-editors to effectively organize the special issue and coordinate with authors, ensuring a smooth editorial process.
  • Inviting contributors from diverse regions, focusing on those with a proven publication record.
  • Promoting the special issue to enhance its visibility and impact.


*The Article Processing Charges (APC) are offered with a discount to facilitate Open Access publishing by the authors.


Qualifications and Experience:

• Ph.D. in related fields

• A valid Scopus ID.

• Prior experience in publishing guest-edited thematic issues in peer-reviewed journals.

• They must have a list of scholarly authors who can consent to contribute research / review articles in the thematic issue(s) proposed by the Topical Issue.

• Strong networks within the research community.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with scientific publication and peer review processes.


Benefits:

• An honorarium to support thematic issue promotion and academic & research endeavors.

• Rapid publication of the special issue, with articles going online within 30 days of acceptance.

• Full APC waiver for an article authored by the Topical Issue.

• A free online subscription to all articles published in the journal during the year.


Location:

This is a remote opportunity, offering flexibility and convenience.


How To Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 December 2025. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines.


Special Instructions:

• Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue.

• Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief.

O que você precisa ter

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Site Reliability Engineering
description:
Quem somos?


Somos parceiros estratégicos de nossos clientes na jornada de transformação digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras para a implementação de tecnologias em nuvem. Com o apoio do nosso time de especialistas, auxiliamos na migração para ambientes em nuvem, modernização de aplicações, segurança de dados, serviços gerenciados e práticas de FinOps eficientes.


Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, busca inovação e acredita no poder da colaboração, temos a oportunidade ideal para você como SRE do nosso time de Suporte e Sustentação!


O seu papel será:

  • Construir e evoluir ambientes em nuvem utilizando infraestrutura como código, garantindo que os projetos sigam padrões de arquitetura, governança, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Atuar na operação e sustentação de ambientes críticos, realizando análises profundas de disponibilidade, capacidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Implementar e manter métricas, dashboards e alertas de observabilidade
  • Atuar no atendimento de incidentes complexos, realizando diagnóstico avançado e implementando soluções definitivas.
  • Apoiar o time de pré-vendas na validação técnica de arquiteturas, esclarecimento de dúvidas e recomendações de melhorias.
  • Acompanhar clientes em reuniões recorrentes, apresentar relatórios técnicos e orientar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao ambiente.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, analisando custos e propondo otimizações para aumentar eficiência e reduzir desperdícios.
  • Construir e aprimorar pipelines de automação e CI/CD, reduzindo intervenções manuais e aumentando a confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas homologadas, monitorando vulnerabilidades e propondo ações de mitigação.
  • Validar e homologar ferramentas técnicas utilizadas pela área, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento com o time, apoiar analistas menos experientes e contribuir para melhoria contínua dos processos internos.


Para participar desse processo seletivo, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prática como SRE, DevOps ou Especialista Cloud, atuando em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade.
  • Vivência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) em nível avançado.
  • Domínio de infraestrutura como código, especialmente Terraform.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, análise de métricas, logs e alertas.
  • Conhecimento em automação, pipelines de CI/CD e integração contínua.
  • Vivência com containers, microserviços, redes e administração de sistemas Linux.
  • Experiência em análise de performance, escalabilidade e estabilidade de sistemas distribuídos.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver incidentes complexos com autonomia e clareza.
  • Comunicação clara para expressar ideias técnicas de forma objetiva e alinhada ao cliente.
  • Pensamento analítico para avaliar cenários com profundidade e tomar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Proatividade para atuar preventivamente, antecipando problemas e propondo soluções.
  • Trabalho em equipe para colaborar com diferentes áreas e sustentar um ambiente de confiança e parceria.
  • Gestão do tempo para organizar prioridades e garantir entregas consistentes.

We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer who is confident in their skills and passionate about their craft. Our ideal candidate has multiple years of experience in frontend software development. You will be working with a group of highly skilled engineers to build the breakthrough solutions while ensuring the system is stable and scalable.


Responsibilities

  • Define and implement engineering best practices and frameworks to uplift our quality and resiliency.
  • Help estimate projects with deadlines, costs, and required resources.
  • Write highly scalable, testable, and resilient code to deliver engaging user experiences.
  • Create technical documentation to support code.
  • Champion CI/CD best practices and implementation.
  • Identify areas to improve and scale our architecture and application design.


Technology Requirements

  • Frontend Expertise : 5+ years of experience building modern JavaScript frontend web applications using frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Web Fundamentals : A solid understanding of semantic HTML, CSS, and core JavaScript principles.
  • Testing Methodologies : Proven experience working in a test-driven or behavior-driven environment.
  • API and System Design : Experience with REST APIs and Event Driven Systems.
  • Database Proficiency : Comfortable working with SQL databases (MySQL & Postgres).
  • Cloud Fundamentals : Experience with cloud platforms and their services (AWS, GCP, Azure).


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to communicate efficiently across the organization.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)


Type: Full-Time


About Indigo Beam

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.


Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.


Project Management:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.


Microsoft DevOps Project Management:

  • Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
  • Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.


Business Analysis:

  • Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.


Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.


Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.


Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Informations:

  • Type of Contract: PJ
  • Hours: Full-time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Duration: Long-term

title: Android Developer
description:
Intermediate Android (Kotlin) Developer

Contract : 3 months + extensions

Remote : Brazil - 40 hours/wk

Rate : USD $15-19/hr


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience with Android Development, including the latest version of Android SDK
  • Ability to write clean code in Kotlin
  • Working experience with Android Jetpack and Design Patterns (MVVM , MVP, MVI)
  • Familiarity with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Familiarity with building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines on GitHub actions


Nice to Have:

  • Other mobile development experience, including iOS development using Swift, or cross-platform development with React Native or Flutter


Job Description:

  • Designing and Building Apps: This involves translating design concepts and user requirements into functional Android applications.
  • Writing Code: Using programming languages like Java and Kotlin to create the app's logic, features, and user interface.
  • Working with the Android SDK: Utilizing the Android Software Development Kit (SDK) to access device features like the camera, GPS, and sensors.
  • Creating User-Friendly Interfaces: Designing intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces that are consistent with Android design guidelines.
  • Implementing App Navigation: Developing clear and logical navigation flows within the app.
  • Optimizing for Different Screen Sizes: Ensuring the app looks and functions correctly on a variety of Android devices with different screen sizes and resolutions.
  • Testing App Functionality: Conducting thorough testing to identify and fix bugs, errors, and performance issues.
  • Debugging Code: Using debugging tools to identify and resolve issues in the app's code.

title: PESSOA REDATORA SÊNIOR - VAGA AFIRMATIVA
description:
