Área de atuação: Comunicação Interna & Publicidade 


Sobre diversidade

Na DALE, valorizamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo. Acreditamos que diferentes trajetórias geram ideias mais criativas e soluções mais potentes, além de fortalecer um ambiente com repertório sociocultural ampliado. Incentivamos fortemente candidaturas de pessoas negras, pardas, indígenas, mulheres, pessoas LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência e 50+.


Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa redatora sênior capaz de transitar com fluidez entre comunicação interna e publicidade. Procuramos alguém com repertório jornalístico, domínio de copy e desenvolvimento de conceitos, confortável em atender vários clientes e articular entregas com criação, conteúdo e planejamento.


Objetivo

Ser a referência editorial e estratégica dos clientes da DALE: levantar e refinar briefings, apurar e organizar informações (tom jornalístico), transformar em narrativas claras e persuasivas para públicos internos e externos, garantir consistência de tom de voz e qualidade das entregas de ponta a ponta.


O que você vai fazer (principais responsabilidades)


  • Comunicação interna: comunicados, canais internos, redes sociais corporativas, intranet, campanhas de endomarketing, manuais e guias, newsletters internas, roteiros de vídeo e apresentações.


  • Marketing digital comunicação externa: calendários editoriais, copies para redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram, etc.), roteiros, landing pages, e-mail marketing, anúncios (hooks, CTAs) e cases.


  • Conduzir entrevistas e apurações com stakeholders; transformar insumos técnicos em linguagem acessível.


  • Criar conceitos criativos (tanto internos quanto externos), defender racional e garantir aderência à estratégia do cliente.



O que buscamos?

  • Formação em Jornalismo, Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência comprovada como pessoa redatora sênior (portfólio com peças de CI e de marketing digital).


  • Português impecável (clareza, coerência, revisão final) e capacidade de adaptação de tom de voz.


  • Vivência em comunicação interna (canais, endomarketing, executivos, cultura).


  • Vivência em social media/marketing digital (copy, funil, SEO básico, UX writing desejável).


  • Organização, senso de prioridade e excelente relacionamento interpessoal com times e clientes.


  • Inglês: intermediário ou avançado (desejável).

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (Remote – Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote (Brazil) – São Paulo

Duration: Open-Ended


Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with leadership capabilities and a passion for building high-impact solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end development and deployment of Machine Learning models to solve complex business problems.
  • Write and maintain clean, efficient, scalable code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and support data-informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies, including deep learning and modern frameworks, to build robust models.
  • Take ownership of key system components and influence the broader technical strategy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to design deployable, production-ready ML solutions.
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, fostering team expertise and growth.
  • Contribute to organizational technical leadership through patent filings and publications in top-tier venues.


Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, pipelines, feature engineering, experiment design).
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as gradient boosting, deep neural networks, transformers, and optimization methods.
  • Experience in Computer Vision ; experience in Causal Inference is highly desirable.
  • Expertise with Python scientific libraries (NumPy, pandas, Polars) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn).
  • Strong data engineering skills and comfort working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python and SQL .


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related fields.
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail industry problems.
  • Familiarity with modern MLOps tools and pipelines .
  • Impact-driven mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience guiding or managing technical teams.

title: Designer de experiência do usuário
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa curiosa, com olhar para experiência do usuário e vontade de aprender na prática, a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) UX/UI Designer Júnior para reforçar nossa área de Produto e UX.

Você será responsável por criar wireframes, fluxos e telas , ajudando a dar mais vazão aos projetos dos produtos da LET’S (como Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.). Vai atuar sempre orientado(a) pelos gestores do time , transformando problemas e requisitos em experiências digitais mais claras, intuitivas e fáceis de usar.


É uma vaga ideal para quem está no início da carreira em UX/UI, gosta de entender jornadas, organizar informação, desenhar telas e quer aprender diretamente com pessoas mais experientes, participando do ciclo completo de produto: discovery, definição, prototipação e handoff para desenvolvimento.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Apoiar na estruturação de fluxos e jornadas do usuário dentro dos produtos da LET’S.
  • Criar wireframes de baixa e média fidelidade (em Figma ou similar) a partir de problemas, briefings e requisitos definidos pelo time.
  • Desenhar layouts de telas e componentes de interface , seguindo o design system e as diretrizes visuais da LET’S.
  • Ajudar a transformar funcionalidades complexas em interfaces simples e objetivas para o usuário final (lojistas, operadores logísticos, entregadores, etc.).
  • Construir protótipos navegáveis para validação interna e com usuários (quando aplicável).
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com Produto, Tech e stakeholders, entendendo contexto e necessidades.
  • Organizar e documentar decisões de UX/UI , fluxos e componentes para facilitar a vida de devs e de outras pessoas do time.
  • Apoiar na manutenção e evolução do design system , ajudando a manter consistência entre os diferentes produtos.
  • Buscar referências, boas práticas e exemplos de UX/UI para inspirar soluções melhores.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência prévia em UX/UI (pode ser estágio, projetos acadêmicos, freelas ou autorais) com portfólio que mostre seu raciocínio de design.
  • Conhecimento básico/intermediário em Figma (ou ferramenta similar) para criação de wireframes, protótipos e interfaces.
  • Noções sólidas de fundamentos de UX : hierarquia de informação, usabilidade, navegação, feedback ao usuário.
  • Noções de UI e design visual : tipografia, espaçamento, alinhamento, contrastes, componentes.
  • Interesse real em trabalhar com produto digital B2B/SaaS (nada de “só layout bonito”: aqui a experiência tem impacto direto no negócio).
  • Vontade de aprender, ouvir feedback, iterar e trabalhar em equipe.
  • Capacidade de comunicar ideias de forma clara , tanto visualmente quanto falando/escrevendo.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com testes de usabilidade (mesmo que simples, acadêmicos ou em projetos pessoais).
  • Noções de HTML/CSS (para entender melhor as limitações e possibilidades na hora de desenhar telas).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de prototipação e handoff (Figma, FigJam, Zeplin, etc.).
  • Experiência ou interesse em produtos B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile .
  • Noções básicas de métricas de produto (ex.: adoção de funcionalidade, engajamento, conversão em fluxos).
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário para consumir material de referência.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


Como se destacar:

Ao se candidatar, envie seu portfólio , mesmo que com projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais, mostrando:

  • Processo , não só telas prontas: problema, contexto, alternativas que você considerou e por que escolheu a solução final.
  • Wireframes e fluxos : como você organiza a informação e constrói a navegação.
  • Exemplos de interfaces em que você aplicou boas práticas de UX/UI (mesmo que não estejam “perfeitas”).
  • Uma breve explicação de como você aprende (cursos, estudos, testes, referências) e como lida com feedback para melhorar seu trabalho.

title: CRO Specialist
description:
Job Type: Remote

Location: Latin America

Availability: Full-time (Mandatory)


Description:

At Elevate Groups USA LLC, we are looking for a conversion architect—not a decorative designer. Your mission: build end-to-end landing pages that are not only visually premium but actually convert. You will be fully responsible for the strategy, design, development, and optimization.


What You’ll Do:

Design and develop landing pages on Shopify with clear conversion-focused narratives.

Implement and analyze A/B tests to optimize performance.

Create premium visual assets using Figma and AI tools.

Optimize page speed, UX, and conversion rates for each page.

Work with full autonomy—from research to deployment.

Essential Requirements


Mindset & Skills:

You think like a direct-response marketer (CRO frameworks, buyer psychology).

You can explain the “why” behind every design choice in terms of conversion.

Portfolio with actual URLs of Shopify pages you personally built.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


Technical Skills:

Advanced Figma (components, prototyping, responsive design).

Shopify (Liquid, advanced CSS, JavaScript, speed optimization).

AI tools (Midjourney/Runway for asset generation).

A/B testing (implementation and analysis).


Nice to Have:

Experience in agencies, freelance, or growth marketing.

Familiarity with premium DTC aesthetics (e.g., Dr. Squatch, HiSmile).

Advanced CSS animations and micro-interactions.

Basic video editing for UGC content.

Experience with Git and theme deployment.

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori/Webdynpro)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno ou Senior com forte atuação em Fiori/UI5 e Webdynpro ABAP para desenvolvimento de novas soluções e evolutivos em ambiente SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.

A atuação é voltada a projetos de desenvolvimento (novos produtos, novas funcionalidades e melhorias estruturadas), com foco em qualidade de código, performance e boa experiência do usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver novas aplicações SAP Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP, incluindo definição e implementação de serviços OData e CDS Views.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações em Webdynpro ABAP, criando novas telas, fluxos e funcionalidades de acordo com requisitos de negócio.
  • Implementar programas, APIs e objetos ABAP (BAPIs, BADIs, user-exits/enhancements) necessários para suportar novas soluções Fiori e Webdynpro.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno, com foco em desenvolvimento (novos projetos e evolutivos), e não apenas suporte/sustentação.
  • Experiência prática com SAP Fiori/UI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, SAPUI5) e consumo/criação de serviços OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações Webdynpro ABAP (criação e evolução de componentes, views e controllers).
  • Vaga CLT


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

title: VENDEDOR EXTERNO JR
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A VITAFOR é uma das maiores empresas de suplementos alimentares do Brasil.


Desde o início trabalhamos para promover a saúde através da nutrição, mostrando que a suplementação é fundamental para o bem-estar humano.


Hoje, temos orgulho de ser “a marca mais premiada pelos profissionais da saúde e nutrição do país”, acumulando diferentes prêmios para o segmento.


Nossa fábrica, localizada na cidade de Araçoiaba da Serra – SP, é a maior e mais moderna do segmento, com laboratório de análises próprio, certificações nacionais e internacionais, além de boas práticas ambientais.


Responsabilidades:

Experiência anterior com vendas em PDVs, preferencialmente em farmácias, lojas de suplementos ou produtos naturais;

Habilidade em negociação e gestão de objeções, com foco em conversão e relacionamento com o cliente;

Capacidade para realizar pesquisas de mercado, identificando tendências, oportunidades e comportamento do consumidor;

Experiência em prospecção ativa de clientes e desenvolvimento de carteira.



Qualificações:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Marketing, Nutrição, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com vendas em PDV; negociação comercial; prospecção.
  • Experiência com a atuação no segmento alimentar, farmacêutico com medicamentos, nutracêuticos.
  • Residir em Feira de Santana.
  • CNH B atualizada e disponibilidade para viagens e pernoite;

title: Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors EC Pleno/Sênior
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essa vaga é para você ! ✨

  • Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors EC PL/SR


Sobre a oportunidade:

  • Início: Assim que aprovado
  • Prazo: Indeterminado, fazer parte do time da consultoria
  • Atividades: O profissional será responsável atendimento de chamados e melhorias das soluções SAP SF EC, garantindo a aderência às demandas de negócio dos clientes e melhores práticas de mercado. Atuar no suporte AMS do módulo Employee Central (EC) do SAP SuccessFactors. Atender, analisar e resolver chamados/incidentes de usuários. Implementar melhorias e parametrizações no sistema. Realizar troubleshooting em integrações e processos de negócio. Documentar soluções, correções e customizações realizadas. Apoiar na atualização e rollout de releases do SuccessFactors. Orientar e treinar usuários finais sempre que necessário. Interagir com equipes internas e clientes para entendimento das demandas. Garantir aderência dos processos de RH ao padrão SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SuccessFactors – módulo Employee Central (EC).
  • Vivência em atendimento e resolução de chamados AMS.
  • Conhecimento em parametrização, configuração e manutenção do EC.
  • Experiência com integrações do SuccessFactors (Integration Center, APIs, conectores).
  • Conhecimento em processos de RH e estrutura organizacional.
  • Capacidade de elaboração de documentação técnica e funcional.
  • Habilidade para mapeamento de processos e análise de regras de negócio.


Diferencias:

  • Certificação SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central.
  • Conhecimento em outros módulos do SuccessFactors (ex: Recruitment, Performance & Goals, Compensation).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou rollout do EC.
  • Atuação prévia em AMS para grandes empresas ou consultorias.
  • Habilidade para realizar apresentações e workshops.


Junte-se a nós e ajude-nos a humanizar o mundo através da tecnologia!

Vem ser #TimeSeidor


Acompanhe a Seidor nas redes sociais:

title: Angular Developer- Realocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are you going to do?

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot and microservices architecture ;
  • Participate in end-to-end implementation projects , from requirements analysis to deployment and support;
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and scalability in cloud-based environments;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical solutions and best practices;
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, testing, and monitoring tools;
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the modernization of the technology stack.


What are we looking for?

  • Strong expertise in Angular (Components, Services, RxJS, Observables, NgRx or equivalent state management tools).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3/Sass , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and micro-frontend architectures is a plus.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma, Jest, Cypress).
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows (Git, Docker, etc.).
  • Fluent English (mandatory) — both spoken and written;
  • Available and interested in realocation to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Data Scientist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Data Science Seniors to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work together with developers, tech leads and solution architects to build applications.

- Improve existing structures by adding new functionalities or proposing technological updates so that as a result, the impact of your contribution is significant in the core of each business.

- The result of your work will also allow you to improve the user experience on scalable and high availability platforms, contributing to the key differential of each business.


Requirements:


- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem solving.

- Hands-on experience with managing data loads and data quality is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Gerente de fábrica de software
description:
Sobre a Empresa

O Gerente de Fábrica de Software será responsável por liderar a equipe, garantindo a execução estratégica e eficiente dos projetos de desenvolvimento de software. Além disso, irá gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, coordenar a equipe técnica e a arquitetura de software, promovendo inovação e melhoria contínua.



Sobre o Papel

Um resumo curto das principais responsabilidades do papel.



Responsabilidades


  • Planejamento Estratégico: Definir e comunicar a estratégia da área de tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais.
  • Avaliação Técnica: Analisar a viabilidade e impacto das demandas recebidas, assegurando que estejam alinhadas com as capacidades e metas da empresa.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Aplicar metodologias ágeis para gerenciar projetos e garantir entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

title: Android Developer
description:
Intermediate Android (Kotlin) Developer

Contract : 3 months + extensions

Remote : Brazil - 40 hours/wk

Rate : USD $15-19/hr


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience with Android Development, including the latest version of Android SDK
  • Ability to write clean code in Kotlin
  • Working experience with Android Jetpack and Design Patterns (MVVM , MVP, MVI)
  • Familiarity with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Familiarity with building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines on GitHub actions


Nice to Have:

  • Other mobile development experience, including iOS development using Swift, or cross-platform development with React Native or Flutter


Job Description:

  • Designing and Building Apps: This involves translating design concepts and user requirements into functional Android applications.
  • Writing Code: Using programming languages like Java and Kotlin to create the app's logic, features, and user interface.
  • Working with the Android SDK: Utilizing the Android Software Development Kit (SDK) to access device features like the camera, GPS, and sensors.
  • Creating User-Friendly Interfaces: Designing intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces that are consistent with Android design guidelines.
  • Implementing App Navigation: Developing clear and logical navigation flows within the app.
  • Optimizing for Different Screen Sizes: Ensuring the app looks and functions correctly on a variety of Android devices with different screen sizes and resolutions.
  • Testing App Functionality: Conducting thorough testing to identify and fix bugs, errors, and performance issues.
  • Debugging Code: Using debugging tools to identify and resolve issues in the app's code.

title: Gerente Executivo Financeiro | Remoto
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Gerente Executivo Financeiro para compor o time Financeiro do Gran e mudar vidas com a gente!


O Gran é um ecossistema que une educação e tecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Hoje temos 2 verticais principais: a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.


Atualmente, são mais de 820 mil alunos e alunas , presentes em mais de 1.500 municípios brasileiros . Temos como motivação possibilitar uma educação de alta qualidade que seja diversa e inclusiva, geográfica e economicamente. Nossa tecnologia de ponta é um catalisador que impulsiona para muitas possibilidades de futuro.


Somos grandes defensores da ideia de que a educação é um direito de todos e fazemos o máximo para tornar isso uma realidade Brasil afora. Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.


Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.


Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.


Se interessou? Vem ser GranLover !

Se você é competitivo, comunicativo e quer transformar performance em prosperidade, esse é o lugar certo pra você!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Sobre a vaga


A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que buscamos?

title: Desenvolvedor de Integrações (APIs)
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos a Cipher, uma empresa do grupo Prosegur especializada em Cibersegurança. A Prosegur é líder global no setor em serviços integrados de segurança (vigilância e tecnologia corporativa), monitoramento de alarmes, transporte de valores. Com uma presença internacional em 25 países a Prosegur, proporciona às empresas e lares, uma segurança de confiança baseada nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado.

Valorizamos e incentivamos o conhecimento técnico e a capacidade de inovar de Nossa Gente e acreditamos que assim é possível atingir nosso propósito de tornar o mundo mais seguro para todos.

Se você se identifica com o nosso negócio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time e acelerar sua carreira.


Quais são os desafios?

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações de APIs em Python e Node.js (REST/GraphQL, webhooks, SDKs).
  • Construir conectores para ferramentas de segurança (ex.: autenticação/identidade, gerenciamento de acessos, WAF, SIEM, EDR) e sistemas corporativos (ERP, CRM, ITSM).
  • Implementar automatizações de processos (jobs, schedulers, filas).
  • Garantir observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing) e qualidade (testes unitários/integrados, cobertura).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança em integrações (auth, tokens, secrets, criptografia em trânsito/repouso).
  • Trabalhar em squads ágeis : participar de plano de sprint , daily , reviews e retros ; colaborar na refinação de histórias e estimativas.
  • Participar de code reviews , documentar integrações (README, OpenAPI/Swagger).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de APIs e integrações em Python (FastAPI/Flask) e Node.js (Express/NestJS).
  • Experiência com versionamento (Git) e CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps).
  • Prática com testes automatizados e documentação de APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Atuação em Scrum ou Kanban , com participação ativa em dailies, planning, review e retro .
  • Colaboração em code reviews , pair programming e definição de padrões (linters, convenções, documentação).
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação / Segurança da Informação e afins;



Diferenciais:

  • Integrações com ferramentas de segurança (ex.: Identity & Access, PAM, Firewalls, EDR, WAF/CDN, CASB, etc).
  • Experiência em cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers (Docker) e Infra-as-Code (Terraform).
  • Conhecimento de GraphQL , gRPC , serverless (Lambda/Cloud Functions).
  • Prática com observabilidade (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Opensearch, OpenTelemetry).
  • Noções de segurança de software (OWASP Top 10, secure coding).


O que oferecemos a você?


Na Cipher nosso beneficio é flexível VR/VA - Flash


Auxilio Home Office, para dar uma força adicional aos gastos do mês, já que estará trabalhando de casa na maior parte do tempo.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

Our client is a remote-first fintech company focused on helping consumers reduce debt through a highly scalable digital lending platform. They value ownership, honesty, curiosity, and low-ego collaboration . They are hiring immediately and have flexibility for phased onboarding.


As a Senior Kotlin Developer, you’ll take full ownership of features from concept to production, working closely with engineering, product, and design.   • Build and scale APIs that power core product functionality
  • Improve system architecture, performance, and reliability
  • Write clean, well-tested code within robust CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers

  • Engage actively in a transparent, remote-first team culture

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • 2+ years building production systems with Kotlin
  • Strong expertise in JVM-based languages and functional programming
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems
  • Background in service-oriented and event-driven architectures
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling
  • Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English
  • A mindset focused on accountability, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, startup-like environments


Why Join This Client


You’ll be part of an engineering culture that values craftsmanship, autonomy, and mission-driven work . This team invests in learning, transparency, and technical excellence. Engineers are trusted to own their work, innovate often, and make a real impact on millions of users.


Additional Tech Environment -


Frontend: React, Next.js, ClojureScript

Backend: Clojure

Data: PostgreSQL

Architecture: Service-oriented, event-driven systems

Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, serverless, CI/CD pipelines

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

title: Analytics Engineer Sênior
description:

Soft Skills

  • Visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Proatividade para propor melhorias estruturais.

Benefícios ATRA

  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta

Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

Please make sure to submit your resume in English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be accepted. The interview process will also be conducted in English.


Smart Age Solutions is a Digital Marketing agency located in New York with a branch in Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for new talents in Brazil who would like to build a career at an American Company!

Here at Smart Age, we offer a wide range of results-driven services and don’t settle for less-than-optimum quality. title: Client Services Representative
description:
Mobility Care Associate


Job Type: Full-time, Overnight Freelancer Position

Location: Remote - Brazil - Work from home

Hours: Set Schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


**** This schedule is set and will not change ****


**** Resumes must be submitted in English ****


On behalf of our client, we are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with excellent communication skills to join the Mindglobal team as a Mobility Care Associate .

Mindglobal , listed in Gartner's 2021 Market Guide, offers corporate TEM (Telecom Expense Management) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises around the world. They are adding new members to their Brazilian team.


Position Overview

As a Mobility Care Associate for Mindglobal , you are responsible for providing customer and technical assistance and support related to mobile device systems, hardware, software, company and carrier processes, and client procedures. You will respond to queries by inbound phone call, email and as assigned, respond in a timely and professional manner, isolate issues and requests, and determine and implement a resolution as per client specific company procedures.


This position is responsible for general customer service and completion of our clients’ day-to-day tasks within measurable SLA metrics.


What you'll do:

  • Quickly and professionally answer inbound client calls according to each client’s preferred greeting and nomenclature
  • Respond to requests for assistance sent by email and received by our Helpdesk Ticketing solution professionally and using appropriate templates, verbiage and guidelines, and within each client’s desired response SLA
  • Understand, access, and efficiently use carrier portals and other tools
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported hardware, Mindglobal tools and carrier systems
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported MDM and related systems, Mindglobal published client- and inside-facing tools, and carrier portals
  • Research process, policy and procedure questions using available informational resources
  • Using appropriate and professional grammar and communication skills, advise client employees on appropriate action(s), timelines, outcomes, etc.
  • Follow Mindglobal’s standard help desk procedures according to each client’s agreements, preferences and processes as noted in the KB, and as may be advised by MCM/CM and Helpdesk management
  • Ensure 100% of your client-related work is entered, tracked and documented in our Helpdesk Ticketing system correctly
  • Provide guidance to clients’ employees on proper use of Mindglobal specific websites and tools
  • Understand and explain client-specific processes and procedures as well as carrier specific data to clients’ employees
  • Refer and redirect non-Helpdesk requests to appropriate resource(s)
  • Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC/Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal’s purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal’s electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal’s purposes


Who you are:

  • Proficient and professional/native level English speaker and writer
  • Able to multi-task and juggle a large volume of tasks
  • Consistently reliable: able to be on time and present when scheduled
  • Professional behavior in the workplace, remotely, and anywhere your Mindglobal affiliation is known
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written
  • Self-motivated to be effective with minimal supervision
  • Detail, process and results oriented
  • Ability to avoid distraction and consistently work throughout a scheduled shift
  • Previous experience in mobile/wireless industry a plus


What Mindglobal offers:

  • Career Growth – Mindglobal prioritizes internal promotions.
  • Remote Flexibility – Work from home in Brazil.
  • Company Culture – A collaborative and supportive team environment.


Job Type: Full-time, Contract position

This is a freelancer position. Benefits (such as healthcare, paid time off or 13th month pay) are not provided. You will be an independent direct contractor ("freelancer") with Mindglobal and paid hourly for time worked. You will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week and as a contractor can choose your time off and holidays.


Compensation & Hours:

Pay: $6.60 USD per hour - This amount of hourly pay is only associated with this “overnight” shift as it includes an overnight pay differential.


Hours: Set schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas


Idioma:

  • English (Obrigatório)

title: Test Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Monetary Metals® is a high-growth company at the intersection of precious metals and finance. The company provides a platform for investors to earn interest on gold and silver while offering financing to precious metals businesses. Our mission is to unlock the productivity of gold and silver, enabling a return to sound money principles in the modern economy.


Position Overview

Monetary Metals (MM) is a disruptive, high-growth gold platform that pays interest to savers, finances qualified businesses, and provides a liquid marketplace for gold leases and bonds. We are looking for an individual who is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing systems that ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of Monetary Metals’ technology platform. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with a talented engineering team to strengthen software quality, testing culture, and deployment confidence across multiple systems.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in test automation with a deep understanding of modern development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and performance testing. You take pride in building confidence in code and in helping developers write testable, maintainable software. This position is a remote opportunity and will report to the Vice President of Software (VP Software).


Key Objectives

·       Develop and maintain comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end test suites for backend and frontend systems.

·       Integrate and optimize automated testing within GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for early and reliable feedback.

·       Conduct load and performance testing to identify bottlenecks and scalability issues.

·       Collaborate with developers to improve code testability and testing best practices.

·       Establish and evolve standards for test coverage, reliability, and reporting across all projects.

Core ResponsibilitiesTest Automation & Quality Assurance

·       Design, implement, and maintain automated tests using Vitest, Cypress, and PHPUnit.

·       Lead QA coverage across systems written in TypeScript (Node, React) and PHP.

·       Create and manage reusable test frameworks and utilities to support scalable automation.

·       Monitor and maintain the health of automated test pipelines to ensure consistent reliability.

·       Document and communicate test results, metrics, and coverage improvements.

CI/CD & Performance

·       Build and manage automated testing workflows integrated into GitHub Actions.

·       Conduct load and performance testing using frameworks such as k6, Locust, or Artillery.

·       Collaborate with developers to identify performance issues early and improve system scalability.

·       Help maintain high deployment confidence and minimal regression risk.

Developer Collaboration & Education

·       Partner with engineers to design testable code and improve code quality during development.

·       Promote a 'test early, test often' culture through mentoring and collaborative practices.

·       Participate in code reviews and provide feedback on testing approaches, coverage gaps, and edge-case handling.

Process & Continuous Improvement

·       Establish clear standards for testing practices, documentation, and QA workflows.

·       Identify opportunities for increased automation, improved efficiency, and stronger feedback loops.

·       Expand test coverage to include negative and edge cases to strengthen system reliability.

·       Contribute to department-wide initiatives aimed at improving reliability, maintainability, and engineering velocity.


Qualifications

·       Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

·       3–5 years of professional experience in QA automation, software testing, or software engineering.

·       Proficiency with Vitest, Cypress, and PHPUnit.

·       Strong understanding of TypeScript and PHP, including writing modular, testable code.

·       Experience integrating automated testing into GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows.

·       Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or Supertest.

·       Experience with load/performance testing frameworks such as k6, Locust, or Artillery.

·       Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills with a proactive, results-oriented mindset.

·       Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.


Compensation & Benefits

·       Competitive base salary (DOE).

·       Stock option eligibility.

·       Flexible paid time off (PTO).

title: Cloud Architect
description:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. title: Social Media Marketing Intern
description:

We are seeking a creative and driven Social Media Marketing Intern to join our team. We value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity, and we welcome people from all backgrounds who are passionate about making an impact.


The program is a 3-month remote internship, during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program.

  • Proven experience in social media marketing or a related field.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with social media analytics tools.
  • Basic design skills (Canva, Photoshop, or similar).
  • A strong sense of creativity, individuality, and self-expression.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Java/Spring Boot
  • Construir e integrar APIs REST de alta performance
  • Implementar soluções em ambiente de nuvem e orquestração
  • Colaborar com times de dados e ML para integrar modelos às aplicações



O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência com Java
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência desenvolvendo APIs REST
  • Experiência utilizando Spring Boot
  • Experiência desenvolvendo aplicações hospedadas em nuvem como GCP, mas experiência com AWS ou Azure também é aceita
  • Experiência com Kubernetes


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!


Benefícios para você:

  • Plano de saúde.
  • Vale Alimentação.
  • Vale Refeição.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Gympass.
  • Meu Pet Club.

Além disso, oferecemos :

  • Incentivo a estudo após 1 ano de Dexian.
  • Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos.
  • Formação através de Trilha de Liderança.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
READ ME: To be considered for this role, please read the full post. Due to demand, we only review candidates who email with the requested details at the bottom. LinkedIn “Easy Apply” submissions will not be reviewed.


About Skip

Skip helps millions of entrepreneurs and small business owners access funding, grow faster, and build real businesses — all in one place. Our revenue is comparable to a high-growth Series B company and has doubled in the past two months. Over 1 million business owners trust Skip to simplify what used to be a maze of red tape.


Now we’re building the next evolution of entrepreneurship: an AI Cofounder that helps anyone start, run, and scale a business.


If you want to work on a product that touches real people — and directly helps them build their livelihoods — Skip is one of the most impactful places you can be.


The Role

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity engineering role.


As a senior full-stack engineer on our product and AI team, you’ll build new tools and experiences that give entrepreneurs real leverage — from conversational business planning to smart funding recommendations, automated documents, and personalized dashboards.


You’ll work directly with the founder and a tight product/design team. No bureaucracy. No layers. Just building, shipping fast, and seeing your work used by hundreds of thousands of people.


What You'll Do:

  • Build and ship new features using modern web technologies and AI APIs.
  • Integrate AI into user-facing flows — conversational builders, assistants, recommendations.
  • Contribute across Skip’s product stack: React/Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Supabase.
  • Rapidly prototype, test with real users, and iterate based on data and feedback.
  • Work closely with product, design, and support to uncover what actually moves the needle.
  • Help shape the architecture and UX of Skip’s AI Cofounder product.
  • (Optional/Secondary) Explore RAG, embeddings, or personalization systems — only if interested.


About You:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience , with strong experience shipping production features.
  • Strong with TypeScript and React/Next.js .
  • Comfortable across the stack or eager to work full-stack.
  • Curious about AI and excited to integrate AI capabilities into real products.
  • Communicative, proactive, and collaborative — you’re comfortable working closely with product and design.
  • You care about impact: you want your work to help real entrepreneurs build real businesses.


Why Join Skip?

  • You’ll be one of the core engineers shaping Skip’s AI Cofounder — a generational product shift.
  • You’ll work with an inspiring, high-output engineering/design team (including a strong Brazil engineering team).
  • You’ll have real ownership — not a feature factory, not endless specs.
  • You’ll see the impact of your work directly: from solo founders to growing teams across the U.S.
  • You’ll ship fast and learn fast.


Compensation:

  • Base Salary: $60,000–$80,000 USD equivalent (paid in USD or BRL)
  • Equity: 0.10%–0.40% — meaningful ownership in a fast-growing company
  • Paid time off + remote-first + autonomy to do your best work


How to Apply


Email:

Subject: Senior Software Engineer Position


Before emailing take a look through Skip including and share in 2-3 sentences why Skip's mission resonates with you and what's most important to you in your next role. You'll get a reply with next steps. We review all applications manually — no LinkedIn black hole.


We're building the future of entrepreneurship. Join us.

title: Especialista Engenharia Mobile (React Native)
description:
Organização de grande porte busca profissional com sólida experiência técnica para liderar uma equipe de desenvolvimento focada em aplicações móveis React Native. O desafio envolve atuar como referência técnica, direcionando o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades estratégicas e promovendo a excelência do produto. O ambiente é dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir arquitetura e padrões de desenvolvimento para aplicações React Native, assegurando qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Orientar e desenvolver o time técnico, promovendo crescimento profissional e colaboração.
  • Interagir com outras áreas para garantir entregas eficazes e seguras.
  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurando aderência a padrões, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar na gestão de projetos, estimando prazos, acompanhando progresso e removendo obstáculos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento mobile, com foco em React Native.
  • Domínio de JavaScript, TypeScript e fundamentos de front-end.
  • Vivência com APIs RESTful e integrações back-end.
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança para desenvolvimento mobile (OWASP Mobile Top Ten).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise estática e dinâmica de código (SAST/DAST).
  • Atuação com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em NodeJS.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo Android (Java/Kotlin) ou iOS (Swift/Objective-C).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Vivência em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Contribuições para projetos open-source.


Comportamentais:

  • Liderança colaborativa e inspiradora.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva.
  • Respeito à diversidade e postura ética.
  • Humildade e responsabilidade.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and onboard world-class creative and production talent. You’ll help build the global network that powers SoCreative — sourcing videographers, photographers, designers, editors, motion specialists, creative leads, project managers, and other key roles across time zones.


This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys connecting great people with great opportunities. If you’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and love building strong talent pipelines, you’ll thrive here.


What you’ll do

  • Source and attract top creative, production, and operations talent across global markets
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle — from job posting to screening, interviews, assessments, and onboarding
  • Build strong talent pools for high-demand roles (design, video, motion, PM, creative leads)
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and refine talent profiles
  • Conduct structured interviews and evaluate candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit
  • Maintain organised, up-to-date applicant pipelines and recruitment dashboards
  • Implement scalable sourcing strategies using LinkedIn, job boards, communities, referrals, and outreach tools
  • Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates to ensure a positive experience
  • Help improve hiring processes, documentation, and workflows as we grow


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or sourcing (creative, agency, or tech experience preferred)
  • Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with modern recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, etc.)
  • Ability to assess creative and operational talent across multiple specialties
  • Clear and confident communication in English, able to manage candidate expectations and present opportunities effectively
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple roles at once
  • A positive, collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility — powered by smart tech, streamlined systems, and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking, and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative, and help shape a modern creative operation — we’d love to hear from you!

title: Analista de Revenue Expansion Sênior
description:
Damos as boas-vindas ao universo de experiências Ingresse ! ️


Somos uma empresa global de entretenimento e líder na América Latina, fornecendo tecnologia, soluções e insights para o setor de eventos.


Acreditamos que o verdadeiro valor da vida está nas experiências que vivemos e nas histórias que compartilhamos. Usamos nosso conhecimento em curadoria e tecnologia para trazer não apenas eventos que estão transformando a indústria e a vida das pessoas, mas também inovações para quebrar a mesmice.


Estamos buscando um(a) Senior Revenue Expansion Analyst, para somar com o nosso time de Comercial !


Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como ponto de contato para novos parceiros, garantindo uma experiência positiva e um relacionamento de confiança desde o primeiro contato.
  • Conduzir todo o ciclo da parceria, desde a integração inicial até o acompanhamento contínuo de performance, resultados e demandas operacionais.
  • Desenvolver e manter uma comunicação empática, clara e alinhada com os objetivos estratégicos de cada parceiro.

description:
About the company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to join our team.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a secure, governed, and cost-transparent AWS Landing Zone, leveraging AWS Control Tower to establish a consistent, well-architected cloud foundation. This foundational work will support the client's future initiatives in data analytics, AI, and workload management.

  • Design the multi-account strategy and VPC network architecture.

  • Implementation of core security services: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and AWS Config.
  • Deployment of automated compliance controls via selected Conformance Packs.

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. title: Assistente de operações
description:
Assistente de Operações

O Assistente de Operações é responsável por apoiar a execução das atividades operacionais em campo e garantir que os processos, rotinas e ações do projeto aconteçam com fluidez, qualidade e alinhamento às metas estabelecidas. É um cargo que atua como ponte entre a coordenação do projeto, as comunidades e as equipes internas, assegurando que as informações circulem de maneira ágil e que as entregas sejam realizadas no prazo. Para ter sucesso nesse cargo, a pessoa precisa ser dinâmica, organizada, comunicativa e manter uma postura proativa diante de desafios, contribuindo diretamente para a eficiência e a consistência das operações.


No contexto da Bee2Be e da organização como um todo, esse cargo desempenha uma função estratégica ao garantir a execução das iniciativas na ponta, fortalecendo a relação com parceiros, promovendo padronização dos processos, assegurando a qualidade operacional e dando suporte contínuo para decisões baseadas em dados e evidências. O Assistente de Operações reforça a cultura de campo, aproxima a organização das comunidades atendidas e sustenta a base operacional necessária para escalar projetos com segurança e impacto.


Responsabilidades

O Assistente de Operações realiza visitas técnicas, acompanha atividades em campo, organiza dados operacionais, monitora metas e indicadores, apoia na implementação de planos de ação, articula com equipes e parceiros, registra informações de forma padronizada e contribui para a resolução rápida de problemas operacionais. Atua em alinhamentos internos, reuniões e ações de mobilização, garantindo que o projeto avance com ritmo, qualidade e consistência.


Qualificações

Para desempenhar esse papel, são desejáveis habilidades de organização, comunicação clara, relacionamento interpessoal, capacidade analítica e adaptabilidade. A pessoa precisa ter iniciativa, perfil mão na massa, habilidade para trabalhar com diferentes públicos e facilidade em lidar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas. Experiência prévia em operações, campo, projetos sociais ou produtivos, além de familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e coleta de dados, são diferenciais que fortalecem o desempenho no cargo.


Formação e Escolaridade

É necessário possuir ensino médio completo. Será considerado um diferencial ter formação técnica ou superior (completa ou em andamento) em áreas como Agropecuária, Agroecologia, Biologia, Zootecnia, Gestão Ambiental, Administração, Desenvolvimento Rural ou Gestão de Projetos. Essas formações contribuem para uma melhor compreensão das atividades em campo, e organização das rotinas operacionais, mas não são obrigatórias para a candidatura.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
